Do you have any information on the history of New Zealand?
In 1947 the country adopted the statue of Westminster, confirming that the British Parliament could no longer legislate for New Zealand without the consent of New Zealand.
Was this period when New Zealand became an independent country?
Sorry I'm not sure about that but the first Europeans known to have reached New Zealand were Dutch explorer Abel Tasman and his crew in 1642.
Thank you! Switching gears, do you have any information on the etymology of New Zealand?
Sorry I don't have information bout that but following Cook, New Zealand was visited by numerous Europeans and North American whaling, sealing and trading ships.
Do you know approximately what period of time that was?
Dutch Explorer Abel Tasman sighted New Zealand in 1642 and named it Staten land in honor of the states general.
Finally, do you have any interesting facts about New Zealand you will share?
Sure, New Zealand experienced increasing prosperity following the second world war and Maori began to leave their traditional rural life and move to the cities in search of work.
Thank you for so much good information! Have a good evening.
No problem.
HI. Can you tell me about the education in Saint Petersburg?
Sure. Saint Petersburg is a city and is located in northwestern Russia. It is near the Gulf of Finland of the Baltic sea. The population as of 2015 is 5 million. It is the 2nd largest city in Russia.
Great. What do you know about the education there?

The well known universities in Saint Petersburg include: Herzen University, Saint Petersburg Polytechnic University, Saint Petersburg Military engineering-tech university, and St Petersburg University of Economics.
Can you tell me anything else about the education system?
I have no more information on education. I can tell you that Saint Petersburg is the cultural capital of Russia.
Do you know anything about sports in Saint Petersburg?
They have Yacht clubs in St. Petersburg . Neva is the oldest yacht club in the world and is located in St Petersburg. They also have the St Petersburg River Yacht Club.
Are any other sports popular?
The club sports legends are Alexander Belov and Vladimir Kondrashin.
Interesting. Any other interesting sports information?
Saint Petersburg's long time basketball team is BC Kondrashin Belov. That team launched Andrei Kirilenko's career.

messages.message: What can you tell me about Hyderabad

Hyderadad is a city in the state of Telangana in India. It has the largest population of any city in the state. Running along the banks of the Musi River, the city has a population of over 6.9 million people, making it the 4th largest city in India. Are there specific topics you'd like to learn more about?
Yes please, I'd like to learn about its history

A scholar of Islamic architecture, Andrew Petersen, says the the city was originally named Baghnagar, which means City of Gardens. Muhammad Quali Qutb Shah established Hyderabad on the banks of the Mushi River in 1591. Since 1956, the Rashtrapati Nilayam in Hyderabad has been the second official residence of the President of India. The Presidents stays there every winter to conduct business.
Can you tell me more

Hyderabad was established as a cultural hub by the Qutb Shahis & Nizams. As such, the city attracted scholars from all over the world. Relics of Qutb Hahi & Nizam rule remain visible within the city to this day. The city remained under the Qubt Shahi dynasty for nearly a century before being captured by the Mughais.
What's the cityscape of Hyderabad like

Unfortunately, I don't have much on the cityscape of the city. I can tell you Greater Hyderabad cover 650 kms, which makes it the largest metropolitan city in India by area. I can continue to research that topic for you, but in the meantime, would you like to delve into the economy, more history or possibly demographics?
Tell me more about the history
Hyderabad is home to a unique dialect of Urdu and is a type of Dakhini. It's call Hyderabadi Urdu and is the mother tongue of most Hyderabadi Muslims.
Any fun fact about the city

Muslims are a minority, but a large minority within the city. Understandable based on the dynasty that established the city. The influence of the Mughalai culture, the group who took the city from the Qutb Shahis, can be found in the city's cuisine.
Any fun fact about the city

The city's one large zoo is the first in India to have a lion & tiger safari park. The Telegu film industry based in the city is the country's 2nd largest producer of motion pictures and has earned the city the nickname Tollywood.
Thank you for your help
It's been a pleasure chatting with you about Hyderabad.
Hi. What can you tell me about Morocco
Morocco is a sovereign country located in North Africa with a long coastline marked by the Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean Sea.
Can you tell me about its history?
Sure! Prior to 1956, Morocco was a French protectorate, but they regained their independence in 1956 and became the Kingdom of Morocco.
Can you tell me more history?

Of course. Morocco claims Western Sahara as a southern province and annexed the territory in 1975. This lead to a war with indigenous forces that lasted until a cease-fire in 1991. There is still a political deadlock over the area.
Wow, that's very tense. What is the country's economy like?
The Economist Intelligence Unit's quality-of-the-index rates Morocco as first of all African countries, even over South Africa.
That's really good! What drives the economy?
I think I remember that it is big in phosphorus, but the specific details escape me. It is the fifth largest economy in Africa and has become a major force on the continent.
Ok. Thank you for all the info!
You are very welcome.
Hi, can you tell me some details about Bridgeport, Connecticut?
sure it is in the United States. Connecticut is the state. Bridgeport is a historic seaport city in the state of Connecticut. It is the most populated city in the state.
Oh, i see; I would like to do my graduation there, so i want to know more about their Educational systems. can you tell me about Bridgeport Education?

It has the 2nd largest school system in the state. it has 20800 students in public schools. It is ranked 158 out of 164 schools districts. It also has the University of Bridgeport. And several other communitiy colleges to choose from as well
Superb! if you have more details about education i am really interested to know
Sure, The University of Bridgeport Ernest C Trefz school of business offers Undergraduate and graduate programs
Thank you, How about their Culture?
Well lets see, between 1972 and 2003 Gustav Meier conducted the symphony orchestra in Bridgeport.
Very Nice, What else you can tell me about Bridgeport?
I thought I lost you for a second. The very first Subway restaurant was also built in Bridgeport
Thank you so much for the all info :)
You are very welcome

Sure! Ghana known formerly as the Gold Coast is a country in West Africa. What else would you like to know?

Yes. Ghana has a strong ties with the United States. Furthermore the 1992 Constitution divides powers among: The Commander in Chief of Armed Forces (president), parliament, cabinet, council of state, and independent judiciary

The Ghana Police Service and the Criminal Investigation Department are the main law enforcement agencies of Ghana. They are responsible for the detection of crime, maintenance of law and order and the maintaining of internal peace and security

Sorry I do not know anything about that, would you like information about Ghana's demographics or more information on the government?
The demographics please.
Sure! The Government of Ghana states that official language of Ghana if English and is spoken by 67.1% of the population.
Thank you so much for all your help!
No problem!

European and Indo-Islamic styles became prominent during Mir Osman Ali Khan's rule.

it is located in the state of Telangana, which is in India.
Cool, what is the population of Hyderabad?
They have the largest population out of all of the cities in their state, it;s 6.8 million!

Hyderabad is twinned with the neighboring city of Secunderabad they are connected by Hussain Sagar.

Estimates of the economy have ranged from $40 billion to $74 billion and have ranked 5th or 6th most productive metro area in India.

I don't see that information, but I did see that the Telugu film industry based in the city is the country's second-largest producer of motion pictures.

Any time!

Of course, Latvia is located in Northern Europe and its capital is Riga

Their economy fell 18% in the first three months of 2009, which resulted to be the biggest fall in the European Union

They are a member of the World Trade Organization and the European Union

They are a member of the league organization they have also held the Presidency of the Council of the European union in the beginning of 2015.
Can you tell me more
They are also a member of the Council of the Baltic Sea States and Nordic Investment Bank.

Would you like to know facts about their politics?
Yes I would.
Their system also existed before World War II.
Thank you for your help!
You are very welcome
Hey! Please tell me about Kent.

Hey! Kent is a county in England. It is south-east of London and is located on the coast. The country grows a lot of fruits such as strawberries and is famous for growing hops, an ingredient used to make beer.
I am a fan of hops! Can you share some of their history?
Yes for almost nine centuries a small part of present day east London formed kent
Okay! Do you have any other info about their history?
Sure. Kent was traditionally partitioned into East and West Kent
What is the culture like in Kent?

There are nine Anglo-Saxon churches in Kent, the man who introduced London to the printing press was born in Kent; the invention was very crucial in forming many Kent Dialect words and spelling to become standard in English.
That is so cool! Is there anything else that you can share about their history.

In 1900, Kent absorbed the district of Penge, and some of Kent is contiguous with the Greater London sprawl. Kent is a very old county, in fact during the 6th and 7th century it was ruled by its own kings.
Thank you so much for your help.
No problem, anything else I can help you with?
I want to learn about Abkhazia.
Hello! Abkhazia's key industry is tourism! What would you like to know?
Can you tell me about tourism while we are on that subject?
I don't have any more information about tourism right now unfortunately, would you like to learn about the history instead?
That would be great!

Apparently there is some anonymity between Georgians and Abkhazians. Sixteen Georgians were said to have been killed and many more injured for trying to enroll in a Georgian university instead of an Abkhaz one. How terribly sad.
Oh wow! That is super sad! Can you tell me about the economy?
Actually I am without information regarding the economy. Would you like to hear about the demographics instead?
Sure!
Teachers have switched from Abkhaz-language teaching materials to Russian-language materials due to schooling in that language ending. Quite interesting.
That's very interesting! I'd like to know about politics and government now.
The pre-Georgian government kept a foothold on Abkhazian territory until 2008!
Anything more you can tell me about this?
I can tell you that after a boom in tourism, many Russian businesses started investing into the Abkhazian tourist infrastructure.
Thank you for all of the great information! I enjoyed it.
It was all my pleasure! I hope you have a great night!
Hello! I'd like to learn more about Sierra Leone. Can you give me some information?
Are you interested in learning more about the society there?
Yes, that would be great!
Krio is the language most spoken there. It is derived from English and several indigenous African languages.
Interesting - is there a large English influence on the culture there?
Yes, actually, English is the official language spoken at schools, government administrations, and in the media.
Totally makes sense, speaking of government. Can you tell me more about the Economy there?

Shipping is big there. Sierra Leon has the largest natural harbour on the African continent, allowing international shipping through the Queen Elizabeth II Quay in the Cline Town area of eastern Freetown or through Government Wharf in central Freetown.
Interesting - is there anything else you can tell me about the economy?
The country produces titanium, bauxite, and gold. It also has one of the world's largest deposits of rutile. Despite all the riches, 70% of the people live in poverty.
Thank you so much for all of this information. This was very helpful.
You are very welcome!
Hello. I'd like to learn about Gujarat
Okay! Gujarat is a state in the Republic of India and its capital is Gandhinagar. The city is named after Mahatma Gandhi, just as an added fun fact.
Thank you. What could you tell me about the economy?
Well, currently it is the largest producer of milk products in India.
Cool. I would like to transition to the geography now. What could you tell me about it?
It is part of the Western Railway Zone of the Indian Railway.
OK. Any other interesting facts about the economy Gujarat?
In addition to milk, it is the main producer of tobacco, cotton, and ground nuts in India.
Are there a lot of native species
I'm unsure. However, there was a period of time before the development of these milk-producing companies that India was the most milk-deficient country world-wide.
Do you know how they are so efficient with producing so much milk, tobacco, and cotton?
I can tell you that Amul milk cooperative federation is well known all over India as Asia's largest dairy.
Thank you. Could you provide another cool fact before we end the chat today?
Sure. Amul was formed as a dairy cooperative in 1946!
Thank you. Have a great night!
Hi, I'm interested in learning more about Yukon.
Hello. The Yukon is a territory of Canada, north of British Columbia.
Wow! Please tell me some history facts there.
Many people came to live in the Yukon during the Yukon Gold Rush of the 1890's. Mount Logan, at 5959 metres above sea level is Canada's highest mountain.
I didnt know that. Please tell me more.
Long before the arrival of Europeans, central and southern Yukon was populated by First Nations people and the area escaped glaciation.
What is the culture like in Yukon?
Notable residents have included Leslie Nielsen, Erik Nielsen, and Pierre Berton.
Please elaborate more.
Sorry but I don't have much information on these people.
It's okay. Please tell me more about their culture.
It has the smallest population of any province or territory in Canada, with 35, 874 people, although it has the largest city in any of the three territories.
Impressive! What other fund facts can you tell me?
According to the 2006 Canada Census the majority of the territory's population was of European descent, although it has a significant population of First Nations communities across the territory.
Thanks for that information! That's all I needed.
Absolutely!
Hello. Could you tell me something interesting about Indonesia?

Yes, there is a lot of interesting information about Indonesia. It's in Southeast Asia and part of Australasia/Oceania and the Malay Islands. There are over 18,000 islands in the Malay Islands! That is a significant amount! I have some more interesting facts to start with if you'd like them.
That would be great. Could you start with some more facts about their demographics?

As of 2004, there were over 238 million people living there, half of them living in Java. That makes it the 4th most populated country in the world. There are a total of 737 languages spoken there! The official language, however, is Bahasa Indonesia.
Wow, that's a lot of people. What can you tell me about there culture?

I don't have a lot of information about that, but Indonesia has the largest population on earth. They also follow Christianity, Hinduism and Buddhism. I'll try to see what else I can find about the culture.
Wow. The largest population is in Indonesia. Good to know! Did you find anything else about the culture?
There is an Indonesian Film Festival that has been held since 1955. There are prevalent influences in Indonesia from the Sudanese, Javanese and Balinese cultures.
Cool. So does Indonesia makes a lot of independent films?
I don't have any information about that, unfortunately. But here's something somewhat interesting: Most Indonesian Hindus are Balinese and most Buddhists are Chinese!
Any other fun fact you want to leave off with today?
Yes! There is a shadow puppet theater that has several mythogical legends such as Ramayana and Mahabharata. It's called Wayang and is Javanese, Sundanese and Balinese.
Great fact! Enjoy the rest of your day
You, too!
What can you tell me about Iowa?
Sure! Iowa is a state in the Midwestern United States. The population has actually increased at a faster rate than other parts of the US and now is mostly an urban population.
Can you tell me about its etymology?
I don't have that information, but I can tell you that Iowa is border by three rivers: Mississippi to the east, Missouri and Big Sioux to the west.
Can you tell me about Iowa's history?
Sure, I'd be happy to answer that for you. The Sauk and Meskwaki tribes, the indigenous people of the area, were pushed out of Iowa in 1846.
Very interesting. When did it become a state?
Iowa became a state in 1846 and was the 29th state to join the United States. I hope that is helpful information.
Very helpful! Thank you very much!
You're very welcome!
Hello, can you please tell me about Western Australia?
Yes! Did you know that Western Australia was the most reluctant participant in the Commonwealth of Australia?
Interesting, what can you tell me about the Media in Western Australia?
There are two daily newspapers: The West Australian, which is an independent tabloid and The Kalgoorlie MIner.
Great, do you have anymore information about the Media in Western Australia?
Yes I do! There is also a weekend paper called The Weekend Times and one Sunday tabloid paper by News Corporation called The Sunday Times.
Thank you, can you tell me about the Sister states of Western Australia?
Unfortunately, I do not have that information, I can tell you that about half of Australia's live cattle exports from from Western Australia
Great, thank you.. can you tell me something else interesting about Western Australia?
Yes I can! Western Australia is a state that occupies the entire western third of Australia!
Thank you for your help today
Of course!

messages.message: what can you tell me about the falkland islands?

The Falkland Islands are a group of islands in the South Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of South America. The capital is Stanley on East Falkland. Falkland islanders are British citizens and speak English.
thanks what can you tell me about its etymology?
The name "Falkland Island" comes from Falkland Sound, the straight that separates the two main islands. The United Kingdom and Argentina both claim the islands.
what else can you tell me about its etymology?
Argentina does not recognise the Falkland Islanders as a partner in negotiations. The name was applied to the channel by John Strong,captain of an English expedition that landed in1690.
what can you tell me about its geography?

There are many islands in the group nut the two biggest are East Falkland and West Falkland. As of 2016 3,398 people live on them. As a territory of the United Kingdom, the Falklands are part of the overseas countries and territories of the European Union.
what else can you tell me about its geography?

As a British overseas territory, the Falklands have internal self-guidance and the United Kingdom takes responsibility for their defence and foreign affairs. A British military is stationed on the islands.
that is all for now thank u
Your welcome and have a great weekend.

The large population of Syria Made it one of the most important of the Roman and Byzantine provinces specifically in the 2nd and 3rd centuries.
Wow. I did not know all of that. I would like to learn more about Syria's history.
Well, when France fall in 1940 during World War ll Syria was owned by by Vichy France until 1941 when Britain and Free French occupied the country
Oh. That's interesting. Could you please tell me some facts about Syria's economy?
I'm sorry. I don't have information on its economy but I know that Syria remained in Lebanon until 2005.
That's okay. Can you give me some more historical information about Syria?
Yes I can, in October 2017 around 400,000 people were killed in the war according to the United Nations.
That's sad. Which war was this?
The Syrian Civil War. Syria fough for control over Lebanon.
Thanks a lot! You've taught me so much.
You are more than welcome :)

There are approximately 50 Jews left in Yemen .
Wow that is a surprise. What is that in comparison to the population in Yemen?
I do not know the population but I do know that The Yemen Football Association is a member of FIFA and AFC .

The latest addition to Yemen 's list of World Heritage Sites is the Socotra Archipelago .

The coastal areas of Yemen and Socotra island also provide many opportunities for water sports , such as surfing , bodyboarding , sailing , swimming , and scuba diving .

That is something I can not answer but I do know that Yemen is both the poorest country and the most water-scarce country in the Arab world .

Barjora, Gangajalghati, and Sonamukhi contituencies are part of Durgapur.

Singapore is a island country and state at the southern end of the Malay Peninsula in Asia

The best known global brands are Singapore Airlines, Port of Singapore, and Changi Airport.all of these brands are apart of the most awarded in their respective industry sectors

I dont have the information but I can tell you that there are more then 7000 multinational corporation from Japan, United States, Europe and Singapore.

your welcome

Hello. Missouri is one of the 50 states in the US. Its capital is Jefferson City. The largest cities in Missouri are Kansas City and St. Louis.

Ozark like the Netflix series? Wow, that's cool. What can you tell me about its culture?
White palace was filmed in St. Louis. Also, filmmaker and animator, Walt Disney, spent most of his childhood in the Linn county town of Marceline before settling in Kansas City.

John Carpenter,s

Sure! New Brunswick is located in eastern Canada. It is almost entirely located within the Appalachian Mountain range.

According to the constitution of Canada, New Brunswick is the only bilingual province!
Interesting. Do you have more information on its culture?
Sure. Theatre New Brunswick travels all around the province performing. Also, Symphony New Brunswick tours quite extrensively.
Thanks. Do you have any information on its infrastructure?
Unfortunately, I don't. Would you like information on their government?
Sure what can you tell me about the New Brunswick government

Their government has 49 representatives that are elected to the Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick. Also, the two largest political parties there are the New Brunswick Liberal Association and the Progressive Conservative Party of New Brunswick.
Do you know how many members New Brunswick sends to the Canadian legislature?

I don't have that information. However, on the topic of infrastructure, I can tell you that NB Power operates 13 of New Brunswick's generating stations. They derive power from fuel oil and diesel, hydro, nuclear, and coal.
Good stuff. Thanks much for the information. Have a good evening.
You're welcome!
Hi.. Please tell me some interesting stuffs about Iceland
Certainly, Iceland is an island country in North Atlantic, between Greenland and Norway. It formerly was a posession of Denmark.
Is Iceland the coldest region of the world
Sorry, I don't have that information, but one interesting fact is that Iceland is a juncture of the North Atlantic and Artic Ocean.
Please tell me more about Iceland population
There are about 329,100 residents who live in Iceland.
How many states do we have in Iceland
Sorry, I don't have that information, but one interestinfg fact is that the nearest part of the Continental Europe is mainland Norway, about 970km away, while mainland North America is 2070 km away.

In 2009, Iceland became the first country with an openly gay head of government when Johanna Sigueoardotir became prime minister.

Iceland is a member of the European Economic Area, known as the EEA, which allows the country access to the single market of the European Union.

it was my pleasure. Till next time.

I can tell you about the politics of Mozambique, if you would like?
That's just what I want to learn about, thanks.

Mozambique has a semi-presidential representative democratic republic. Whereby the President of Mozambique is the head of state and the head of government, all in a multi-party system.
Oh wow, that is very interesting. I think I've learned enough about their politics. Can you tell me about the economy?
Yes! The economy of Mozambique has developed since the end of the Mozambican Civil War. In 1987, the government embarked on a series of macroeconomic reform designed to stabilize the economy.
Oh wow, so it sounds like they are doing well. Anything else you can tell me about the economy...many trade exports?

The railroads were major targets during the Mozabican Civil War, were sabotaged by RENAMO and are being rehabilitated. Major trade exports from Mozambique included sugar, citrus, copra, coconuts and timber
Oh wow, that is really something. You have been a great help tonight. Are there any fun facts you can share?
So, Northern Mozambique lies within the monsoon trade winds of the Indian Ocean.
Thanks so much, good night.
Of course, youre welcome!

Medical education programs have been established in New Brunswick at the universities, Universite de Moncon and UNBSJ in Saint John.

More than half of the province's population live on the Avalon Peninsula of Newfoundland, the capital and site of historical early settlement.

messages.message: What can you tell me about Newfoundland and Labrador?
It's a province of Canada. Would you like to know about the geography?
The history please.
Humans can be traced back 9000 years in Newfoundland and Labrador. In 2001, an amendment was made to the Constitution of Canada to change the name to Newfoundland and Labrador.
Wow so long ago. Tell me more.

Since the early 1800s, Quebec has been in a dispute with Newfoundland over the Labrador region. In 1927, the British government wanted the area that was known as Labrador to be considered part of the Dominion of Newfoundland.
What do you know about the preconfederation and current provincial anthem?

In 1980, the present provincial flag was first flown on "Discovery Day" that year. The artist of the flag was Christopher Pratt. In 1980, a song was re-adopted as the anthem which made it the only province in Canada to officially adopt an anthem.
That's a cool fact! Do you have anymore interesting facts?

For some reason, some tourists think it's an Irish flag. lol The flag has blue triangles and that's a tribute to the Union Flag and represents the British heritage. Pratt, the artist, said that the golden arrow points toward a "brighter future".
Those silly tourists! Thanks for all your help today I learned so much.
You are welcome! Have a good evening!
Can you tell me about Gabon?

Sure! Gabon is located on the equator in the continent of Africa. It received its independence from France in 1960 and the capital city is Libreville. Would you like to learn about the history of Gabon?
Yes please.
You got it! Gabon was a territory of French Equatorial Africa from 1910 to 1959. Since gaining independence in 1960, the country has had only 3 presidents.
Wow, do you know anymore about their history?
Yes, in fact, it was French explorer Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza who first led a mission to the Gabon-Congo area in 1875.
Very interesting. Do you happen to know anything about the demographics?
I do! About 1.5 million people live in Gabon and it is considered one of the richest countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. However, the income is unevenly distributed and many people live in poverty.
That sounds familiar. Would you happen to know the etymology?
Unfortunately I do not have that information, but I can tell you that the country has a very low population density among other African countries.
I did not know that. Any info on the government or politics?
Absolutely! Gabon is a member of several international organizations, including the United Nations, the African Union and the International Monetary Fund.
Cool, any other interesting facts?
Continuing on the subject of government, Gabon has a National Assembly and Senate as part of it's 2-chamber legislature.
Thank you for your help!
You're welcome!

Unfortunately I do not have that information. I can tell you that in July 2015 Obama visited Kenya the first American president to visit the country while in office.

On December 12, 1964 the Republic of Kenya was proclaimed! Jomo Kenyatta became the first president of Kenya. For some fun facts did you know Kenya has the fastest marathon runners in the world and have always won the Boston Marathon!

Studies on climate change have repeatedly shown that climate change will affect Saskatchewan's agriculture. However, whether or not the effects of climate change can be mitigated through adaptations of cultivars or crops is unclear.

SaskPower, SaskEnergy, and SaskTel accounted for approximately 88.4% of Crown Debt as of March 31, 2016.

Kosovo is a territory in the Balkans. It's disputed whether it's a country or not. The dispute is between the Kosovan authorities, which support independence & the Servian authorities, which oppose Kosovo breaking from them. The Serb minority in Kosovo has formed the Community Assembly of Kosovo & Metohija to fight independence.
when was the Community assembly of Kosovo and Merohija formed

Unfortunately, I don't have the date of when the Community Assembly was formed. After NATO bombed Yugoslavia in 1999, the territory cam under the administration of the United Nations. Serbia recognizes administration of the territory by Kosovo's elected government, but it continues to claim it as the Autonomous Province of Kosovo & Metohija.

It's located strategically in Southeastern Europe and has species from both Europe & Eurasia..Kosovo represents 2.3% of the entire surface area of the Balkans. Kosovo has 25% of the Balkan flora & almost 20% of the European flora. Most of central Kosovo is made up of vast plains.
cool what else can you tell me

Kosovo is landlocked & located in the center of the Balkan Peninsula. Kosovo has the largest percentage of Muslims after Turkey. From an historical standpoint, Kosovo was occupied by Bulgaria & Austria-Hungarian troops during WWI after the retreat of the Serbian army.
I did not know that what can you tell me about the people of Kosovo

nice, did you find anything about the history

Because of the dominance of the Democratic party in Chicago, The Democratic primaries are general more significant than the general elections in November for the US House and Illinois State Seat.

Caterpillar had plans to move its global headquarters, with 300 executives and staff personnel, to the Chicago suburb of Deerfield, by the end of 2018.

messages.message: Hello, I would like to learn about Sierra Leone.
I would be happy to help you with that today. Sierra Leone is a country in West Africa. Its capital is Freetown. Would you like information on the Government and Politics there?
I would!

Great! The country was first formed as a place where freed slaves could live. From 1991 until 2000, there was a civil ware in Sierra Leone between rebels and the government. Sierra Leone is a member of the International Criminal Courts and holds a Bilateral Immunity Agreement of protection for the US Military. The Seirra Leone Police is headed by the Inspector General of Police. He is the professional head of the Sierra Leone Police force and is appointed by the President of Sierra Leone.
Do you know what year the country was formed?

Here's what I have about the formation of Sierra Leone. In 1953, Sierra Leone was granted local ministerial powers. However, it wasn't until April 27, 1961 when Sir Milton Margai led the country into independence from Great Britain and he became the countries first Prime Minister. Then on April 19, 1971 Sierra Leone actually became a republic.
Interesting! Do you have any more information about its history?

I do! A little more about April 19, 1971- Siaka Stevens helped abolish Sierra Leone's parliamentary government system and declared it a presidential republic. This created a one-party state from 1978 till 1985. The country is known for its blood diamonds. These were mined and sold during the civil war in order to buy weapons.
Are blood diamonds still prevalent there today?

The most prevalent natural resource Sierra Leone has is the diamond. Though the country is also one of the worlds largest producers of titanium and bauxite as well, Sierra Leone has relied heavily on diamonds for its economic base.
Thank you for all of the information today!

You're so welcome! Here's a fun fact for you: The Settlers who built the capital Freetown, did so in the styles they knew from their lives living as slaves in the American South. They also continued American fashion and American manners.

You're welcome. Goodbye

That said, White Americans (mostly European ancestry group with 73.1% of total population) and are the largest racial group. The largest racial minority being Black Americans. This doesn't include Hispanic and Latino Americans, as they are counted as an ethnic group and not a racial group. They are also the third largest ancestry group. The Asian Americans are then the second largest racial minority.
Just to clarify, Hispanics and Latinos are the third largest ancestry group?

I do apologize and I appreciate you asking that question. I misread the information provided to me and in my previous statement it is actually the Black Americans who are the third largest ancestry group. My apologies. Unfortunately I don't have any information on that specific area itself at this time. For instance, there were three amendments that were added to the U.S. Constitution years following the civil war that created unrest back, people can be ignorant in my opinion and cruel, and I've heard stories of what happened in the years that followed that most certainly involved the law enforcement on various angles unfortunately. Those three amendments were 13 and 14 which provided citizenship to nearly four million African Americans, and the 15th amendment that was to ensure that they also had the right to vote.
Such a turning point in history! Unfortunate that things seem to be back tracking. Can you give me any more information on their law enforcement and crime?

Indeed, the turning points don't seem to stop. I guess that can be good or bad depending. Regarding specifics on crime and law enforcement though, I'm not finding anything notable outside of pop-culture I know of myself. For instance there was a police shooting in Florida that occurred not too long ago, and the shooter was tried and found guilty recently. That type of violence is always a threat. However, back to the previous fact, I imagine the law was involved up to the point that a war broke out about those three amendments, the Civil War. In a way that could be viewed as "law enforcement". I also think too though that the large variety of crimes and injustices that they face are part of why the Constitution has been amended 27 times.
Absolutely! Thanks so much for being so thorough! I appreciate your insight as well! Have a great evening!
You're very welcome, the pleasure has been all mine. Have a great evening and weekend yourself.

The Mid Sussex had a thriving clay industry in the first quarter of the 20th century.

Higher Education is also provided at University Centre Hastings and Northbrook College, whose West Durrington campus is referred to as University Centre Worthing.

The University consistently ranks among the top 20 universities in the UK.

Thank you so much for all of your help today. I am most appreciative.
Glad i could help! until next time.

messages.message: Can you please teach me about Europe?
Europe is one of Earth's 7 continents and is comprised of more than 50 countries. Would you like to know more about the history of Europe?
Oh wow. No, I'd actually like to know about their culture.
European boundaries were initially established based upon Christendom. Throughout history, those boundaries were constantly defended, especially during the Reconquista and Ottoman Wars.
So, do you mean the boundaries were made based on religion?

Yes, historically that was how they were established. Christianity was and still is the largest religion in Europe. 76.2% of the European population considers themselves to one of the various denominations of Christianity.
Well, that's pretty cool. What can you tell me about their demographics?
There is a prediction of population decline in Central and Eastern Europe due to low birth rates as well as people leaving the country.
It seems that is happening in many European countries. What else can you tell me about the demographics?
The regions of Central, Eastern, and Southeastern Europe have the most amount of Slavic speaking people.
Is that the most common language there?

I do not have that information but I do see that there are roughly 225 indigenous languages in Europe. Mostly are the romantic langues that have Latin and Roman roots. Germanic languages are from Scandinavia and the Slavic languages.
No worries, you've been very helpful. Thanks.
You are welcome.
Can you tell me about the geography in Asia?
Asia is the largest continent on Earth.
Can you tell me more
Asia is in the northern hemisphere. Asia is connected to Europe in the west. Together, Asia and Europe are called Eurasia.
What can you tell me about the culture?
Tha Abrahamic religions including Judaism, Christianity, Islam and Baha'i Faith originated in West Asia.
Can you tell me about the climate?

I do not have information about that but a fact I can tell you about is that the black death, one of the most devastating pandemics in human history, is thought to have originated in the arid plains of central Asia.
What can you tell me about the population?
Islam is the second largest and most widely-spread religion in Asia, with at least 1 billion Muslims constituting around 23.8% of the total population of Asia.
Thank you
You're welcome. Have a great day!
Hi! Can you tell me about Mauritania?
Hello, Mauritania is a country in northwest Africa. Would you like to know about the history and politics?
Yes. Specifically it's Human Rights.
According to the US State Department 2010 Human Rights Report, " Government efforts were not sufficient to enforce the antislavery law."
Can you tell me about their Names and Pronunciations?
I'm sorry I don't know about that, but I can tell you that its president is General Mohamed Oueld Abdel-Aziz. Would you like to learn more about its history and politics?
Yes please.
The government was overthrown on August 6, 2008 in a military coup d'etat led by General Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz.
That's interesting! Thank you for that information.
You're welcome!
Is there anything else you can tell me?
Amnesty International accused it of practicing coordinated torture against criminal and political detainees.

I need some help. I have a date with a gal from South Australia. I lied and told her I knew all about where she was from. If it wasn't for the name, I wouldn't even know where it was. I need a crash course bad! Can you help?
Sure thing, South Australia is a state in the southern central part of Australia.
Could you tell me about the sports? She loves rugby!
Australian rules football is the most popular spectator sports in S Australia, with them having the highest attendance rate in Australia.
This is exactly the information I need. Any additional facts about their sports?
SAAFL (South Australian Amatuer Football League) is one of the largest and strongest Australian rules football associations.
Sweet! I wrote that down (SAAFL) and will pick my favorite team after this session. Haha. Are you able to tell me a little about the demographics by chance?
Unfortunately i do not have any information on that I can tell you that in 2002-2003 63% of S Australian children took part in organised sports.
Well if this date goes well, I'm going to invite you to the wedding. You have been a lifesaver for sure. One more random fact please? Something that will really impress her!
I am not sure if this will impress her however the lowest minimum temperature was recorded on July 20th 1976 at -8.2 degrees C.
Haha! I will parlay it into a compliment. Thank you so much. for your help tonight. I am sure all these facts will impress her. Take care my friend!!
Good luck
Hello
Good Evening
I'd like to learn about Mongolia please. What can you tell me about it?
It’s a landlocked country, between China & Russia, in East Asia
That's pretty cool. What does landlocked mean, can you explain that further?
That means it doesn’t have a border on the water. It’s the 2nd largest, behind Kazakhstan, that is landlocked
Oh ok, thanks for explaining that to me. What can you tell me about the economy there? How is it?
It is ranked as lower-middle income by World Bank & has an extremely low crime rate
Is poverty a problem in Mongolia?
Yes, unfortunately the actions of Mongolia’s nobility & the collection of imperial taxes in silver, not animals, has created widespread poverty
Man that's very sad to hear. I hope they can work towards a better way! I'd like to talk about the history of Mongolia now please.
Horses were introduced between 5500 & 3500 BC which became a dominant culture. A mummy of a 30-40 yr old blonde man that was believed to be about 2500 yrs old was discovered
Wow, that's very interesting! Can you tell me more about the mummy that was discovered?
It was discovered in Altai, Mongolia & was believed to have been a Scythian Warrior
Very cool! Do you have any other cool facts?
Genghis Khan, the ruthless leader of the Mongolian Empire is from there
NIce! Well thanks so much for the chat, Have a good evening.
You too & you’re welcome
Hello there! What can you tell me about the culture in Morocco?
Hello!! Moroccan has many influences in their culture. There is a blend of Arab, Indigenous Berger, Sub-Saharan African, and European. Andalusian classical music is very popular there.
Great! What more can you tell me about influences in their culture?
Oral literature is a big part of Moroccan culture. It could be Moroccan, Arabic or Berber. Architecture also is of interest in Morocco blended with islamic styles.
That is great information about the cultural influences in architecture, literature, and music! Can you tell me a little more about this?

Moroccan intellectuals were given the opportunity to exchange and produce literary works by a French and Spanish protectorate. The architectural styles are shaped by the religious and cultural influences of the indigenous Berber people and foreign invaders.
Wow, those are great intellectual details! Do you have any details about demographics?
Moroccan Jews are thought to constitute the second largest Jewish ethnic subgroup. Morocco is a member of the Arab League, the Union for the Mediterranean and the African Union.
That's interesting, I didn't know that. What other details do you have?
Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium have large communities in Morocco. Spain has about 700,000, the Netherlands has 360,000 and Belgium has 300,000.
Ok, what else can you tell me about communities in Morocco?
Spain had preciously occupied northern Morocco and the Spanish Sahara so they mostly speak spanish. There are an estimated 8,000-40,000 Moroccans who converted to Christianity.
That is all great information about Morocco especially about its culture and demographics! Can you tell me one more fun fact about Morocco?
Morocco became the first Arab and African country to qualify for the second round of the FIFA World Cup. That was in 1986.
FIFA is fun! Thanks for all the great details about Morocco! Good day!
Good day to you too!!
Can you tell me about Sambalpur?
Sure! Sambalpur is a city and Municipal Corporation located in the western part of Odisha, and is one of the largest and oldest cities in the state.
I had no clue, can you give me an overview?
Alright. After the independence of India, many commercial and government establishments sprung up in and around Sambalpur.
Interesting, do you know the population by chance?
I'm sorry, I do not know their population. But I can tell you that Sambalpur is one of the ancient places of India, with recorded settlements in the prehistoric age.
Wow, any information on the education?
Yes. High School for Blind and High School for Deaf and Dumb, Burla are Govt. educational institutions imparting education to physically challenged children.
That is nice, anything else about the education?
The schools are affiliated with either the Orissa State Board under BSE or CHSE, Indian Certificate of Secondary Education and the Central Board for Secondary Education.
Cool, any fun facts?
Did you know Sambalpur was the first in India to adopt clean coal combustion technology that uses a circulating fluidised bed, which is considered environmentally friendly.
Thank you for your help!
You're welcome!
Can you tell me about Bulgaria?
Did you know that Bulgaria has some of the largest Natural 2000 areas in Europe, covering 33.8% of its territory.
What do you know about the culture?
Rakia is a traditional fruit brandy that was consumed in Bulgaria as early as the 14th century.
Really cool that was so long ago. What else do you know about the culture?
Contemporary Bulgarian culture blends the formal culture that helped forge a national consciousness toward the end of the Ottoman Empire rule with millenia-old folk traditions.
Can you tell me about the geography?
It is interesting that over 75% of the surface rivers meet European standards for good quality.
Yes, that is interesting! Tell me more please on geography.
Other major rivers include the Struma and the Maritsa in the south.
Is there a fun or interesting fact you would like to share?
The legal system is regarded by both domestic and international observers as one of Europe's most inefficient due to pervasive lack of transparency and corruption.
That's unfortunately in a lot of places. Thanks for all your help.
YOu are welcome.

The Autonomous Province of Vojvodina (Serbian: Аутономна Покрајина Војводина or "Autonomna Pokrajina Vojvodina") is one of the two autonomous provinces in Serbia. It is located in the northern part of the country, in the Pannonian plain.

The term vojvodina in Serbian means a type of duchy - more specifically , a voivodeship .
Thanks. What is the geography?
A small part of the Mačva region is also located in Vojvodina , in the Srem District .
What are the attractions?

I don't know about the attractions but i do know that the Public Broadcasting Service of Vojvodina was founded in 1974 as Radio Television of Novi Sad , as an equal member of the association of JRT - Yugoslav Radio Television .
Thanks. I want to go to a cheap restaurant.
I don't have any information on restaurants in Vojvodina. Is there something else you would like to know. Maybe about the Culture?
Not at the moment, but thanks for all your recommendations.
Your welcome. Glad I could help!
Hi could you inform me more about Macau?

Sure. Macau is a Special Administrative Region in China and has a large amount of autonomy just like Hong Kong, the other administrative region. It's interesting to note that the Roman Catholic Diocese there manages 27 primary and secondary schools.
It seems church and state are intersecting at those 27 schools...Do they have any schools there that are not tied to religion?

That's a good question that I don't have an answer for right now. I can tell you that the majority of their schools use Cantonese in their instruction and require written education in Chinese and classes in Mandarin. They follow several different educational models including Chinese, Portuguese, Hong Kong and British systems.
Okay great. Diversity is always nice. One more thing on the educational front - do they have any secondary education in Macau (i.e. college)?
I'm not sure but I can tell you that their students at the secondary level who study in nearby Guangdong are eligible for tuition subsidies.
All very interesting. Now, is there any etymology pertaining to Macau?

Yes, quite a bit. It was once a Portuguese colony. When their explorers first arrived, they asked for the place name. But the locals thought they were seeking a temple and told them it was called Ma Kok.
Awesome. By chance, is there more recent, modern etymology there too?

No, nothing more recent. But an interesting bit of information is that the locals believed the sea goddess Mazu, who is also called A-Ma or Matsu, had blessed and protected the harbor. They named the water around the A-Ma Temple after her. There is a festival in April to celebrate her.
They seem to like their religion there. Either way, that's all I needed for now.
Okay. Have a good evening!
Hello, What can you tell me where Cornwall is located?
Cornwall is a country in the far southwest of England.
Oh Cornwall is a country. Can you tell me about its government or governing body?
Cornwall Council consider it's unique cultural heritage and distinctiveness to be one of the area's major assets.
Interesting. Can you tell me more about Cornwall's unique culture?
I do not have information on that at this time.

The only city in Cornwall is Turo.

D.H. Lawrence spent time there.

It is a country in Central America. It is also known as Republic of Nicaragua

I am sorry I dont have that information but I can tell you that in Centeral America Nicaragua is the largest city.

The United States was obligated to make reparation because of the customary international law treaty

The first woman president of that country was Zelaya

The government divided in the 1980s into two autonomous regions the eastern half of the country, this was done for the black and indigenous people and limited self-rule within the republic,

ok, The Macao Special Administrative Region (Macau or Macao) is one of China's two special Administrative Regions.

Yes, Macanese Patois, a local creole generally known as Patua, I snow spoken only by a few in the older Macanese community.
What language does the majority speak?
Portuguese is the official Language alongside Chinese.

Hello! I would like to learn about North Macedonia. Could you share some information?
Hi! Yes. The Republic of North Macedonia, commonly known just as North Macedonia, is a country located on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe.
Thank you. Has the name of this country changed over the years?
Yes. It wasn't until February 12, 2019 that its name became the Republic of North Macedonia, as a result of the Prespa agreement signed by Macedonia and Greece.
Interesting. Do you have any other information about names or etymology as it relates to North Macedonia?
Prior to the Prespa Agreement in June 2018, it was known as the Republic of Macedonia, but the name 'Macedonia' was disputed by Greece. That is why it was changed to North Macedonia.
Do you have information as to why the name 'Macedonia' was disputed by Greece? That's interesting.

Yes. Greece cited historical and territorial concerns for their reasoning behind disputing the name. Greece has a region of Macedonia, and had the ancient Kingdom of Macedon, which falls within Greek Macedonia. So, Greece disputed the name unless they had a geographical qualifier like "Northern" in the name, since it could cause confusion.
Makes sense! Could you tell me about the educational system there?
The education system of North Macedonia consists of pre-school education, primary school, secondary school, and higher education.
How does their educational system compare to other systems in Europe?
Sorry, I don't have that information. But I can tell you that the Ministry of Education and Sciences reported that approximately 462 primary and secondary schools are connected to the internet.
Thank you! You've answered all of my questions. I appreciate your help!
You're welcome. Have a great day!
Hello, I would like to know about Palau and its geography please!
Sure! Palau is officially known as the Republic of Palau. It is an island and its territory consists of an archipelago which is located in the Pacific Ocean,
What part of the Pacific is Palau located anyway? I'm not even sure!
Absolutely! This beautiful island relies in the western Pacific Ocean specifically 300 miles east of the Philippines.
I've always wanted to travel to that part of the world! Can you tell me about the etymology of Palau? I'm interested where the name came from.
Sure! Its name come from the Spanish "Los Palaos" Via the German Palau which by the way is unrelated to Pulau that is a Malay word meaning "island"
Interesting! Do you know what language(s) they speak there?
The name of the islands is Palauan language which is talked in the nation. I don't have any other information regarding the language they speak.
I imagine some of the natives could speak English. I hope so! Thank you for the information. Anything else you can tell me?
Absolutely!, Palau is a territory of the United States because it passed formally under the United Nations auspices in the year 1947 by a Security Council Resolution 21.
Oh wow! I had no idea! I guess maybe they would speak some English there, then. Great news.
I have some new information regarding their language! Many more people in this territory speak English than Palauan!
That's good to know. Thank you so much for your help! Goodbye!
You are more than welcome!
Hello, can you tell me about Eritrea
Hi. Eritrea is a country on the eastern coast of Africa.
Thanks! What can you tell me about the transportation?
About one fifths of the roads in Eritrea are paved.
Any other transportation info?
Italy actually built a railway in Eritrea from the city of Massawa to the other cities of Asmara, Keren and Akordat.
Thanks! What can you tell me about foreign relations?
Eritrea has had a tumultuous relationship with Ethiopia. From May 1998 to June 2000 ,there was a war that caused 70000 lives to be lost during this time period.
Col, what else can you tell me
Since so many lives were lost in this war , it caused the United Nations to criticize Eritrea's human right's record.
Interesting. Any other interesting facts?
Some areas in Eritrea were once Italian colonies. The regions colonized were known as Italian Eritrea. Assab was an area that was affected by Italian colonization.
Awesome, thank you so much for your help!
You're welcome. I hope you learned everything you needed to about Eritrea.
Hello, I would like to know more about Western Sahara

Western Sahara is a territory in Africa. To the north is Morocco, to the east is Algeria, to the south is Mauritania, and to the west is the Atlantic Ocean. Its surface is. It is one of the most sparsely populated territories in the world.
Could you tell me more about its location?
Western Sahara is located on the northwest coast in West Africa and on the cusp of North Africa.
What is its climate like?
I'm sorry I do not have that information right now.... but i can share this about the history.......A few days before, on 31 october, Moroccan troops invaded Western Sahara from the north.
No problem, can you tell me about its dispute?
of course...... During the joint Monocan-Mauritanian control of the area, the Mauritanian-controlled past, roughly corresponding to Sequia el-Hamra, was known as Tiris al-Gharbiyya
Interesting, was there more to that?
In 2005, Minurso lodged a complaint to the Security Council of the United Nations for "military maneuvers with real fire which extends to restricted areas" by Morocco.
Any additional information I should know?
In March 2016. Monocco "expelled more than 70 U.N. civilian staffers with MINURSO" due to strained relations after Ban Ki-moon called Morocco's annexation of Western Sahara and occupation
Thank you for all of your help! You have been great!
you are so welcome i am glad i could help
Hello. I would like some information on Italy please.
Would you like to learn about Italy's politics?
Yes that would be great!
Okay, Sergio Mattarella who is also the President of Italy has been Italy's head of state since 2015.
That's interesting information. Do you know how long the President's terms are? Are they 4 years like in the US?
In Italy, the President is chosen for single seven years by Parliament as well as regional voters together.
Wow! 7 years is a long time. What political parties do they have in Italy?
Italy has three political parties. They are the Five Star Movement, the Democratic Party, and the Lega.
I've only heard of one. ha! What can you tell me about their demographics?
Compared to other Western countries, Italy has an under 10% adult obesity rate. This is primarily due to the Mediterranean diet there.
Oh really? That's interesting. Maybe I should check into that!! Do you know approx what the population is in Italy? I'm sure it's very high.

I don't know the exact population there but I can tell you that Italy's population has doubled during the 20th century. The growth did not happen at once due to the large mass of migration from the country South to the industrial cities in the North. This large migration is due to the Italian economic miracle in the 50s and 60s.
That's awesome. I figured it was pretty high. Hey, thanks for the great information on Italy. Have a great day!
My pleasure.
Can you tell me about the Geography of Moldova?

I'm sorry, but I currently don't have any information regarding Moldava's geography. I do have facts regarding Moldova's government. Since declaring independence in 1991, Moldova has participated in peacekeeping missions in multiple countries.
Can you tell me more about Moldova's government?
Poland provided Moldova with 15 million US dollars as a component of its support in its European integration efforts.
That is very interesting! Can you tell me about Moldava's economy?
Moldova's government entered into agreements with the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund to promote growth.
Thank you. Can you tell me more about Moldova's economy?
In August 2013 Moldova began work on a new pipeline that may eventually break Russia's monopoly on Moldova's gas supply.
Wow. Can you tell me more about the pipeline's progress?

Unfortunately, I do not have any information on the pipeline's progress. I can tell you Moldova has few natural energy resources and therefore it imports almost all of its energy supplies from Russia and Ukraine.
That was very informative. What do they import?
Moldova imports natural gas from Russia.

thank you so much

Sure Thing. Here is a fact...The Soviet Union (short for the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics or USSR) was a single-party Marxist–Leninist state. It existed from 1922 until 1991. It was the first country to declare itself socialist and build towards a communist society. Would you like to know more about the Soviet Union?
Yes please. Any of its social history would be great.

In regards to the Soviet Union, About 90 percent of the Soviet Union 's Muslims were Sunnis , with Shias being concentrated in the Azerbaijan SSR. Would you like to know more about the social history?
Yes please

In 2016 Documentation revealed the Soviet Union 's plans for a statewide doping system in the sport of track and field in preparation for the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles . They wanted Gold very badly....do you want to know more about sports?

happy to help.
Hello and good evening! Hope you had a great day! I am excited to chat with you about Tuvalu. I know nothing about it. Where is it located?
Tuvalu, also know as Ellice islands, is located in the Pacific Ocean. At the current rate of rising sea levels, the island will by under water in the next 50 years.
What?! Underwater? Wow! What can you tell me about the society there?
Sure! The national languages spoken on the island of Tuvalu are English and the Tuvaluan langauage.
English? Are there any other languages spoken there?

Actually, the Tuvaluan language is from the Ellicean group of Polynesian languages. They are related to all the other languages of Polynesia such as Hawaii, Maori, Tahitian, Rapa, Nui, Samoan, and Tongan.

Wow! Now that is interesting. Now, you said earlier that the island was at risk of being underwater in 50 years, can you tell me about the impact of climate change? I'm sure that it has something to do with that fact.

Sure! At the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference, It was stated that the global goal should be below 1.5 degrees Celsius as compared to the pre-industrial temperature levels. The Alliance of Small Island States stands firm on this position.
Good way to get started. Any other information on the impact of climate change?

The sea-levels are measured by satellite altimeters near Tuvalu. Since 1993 the sea rises about 5 mm per year. This reports was done in 2011 by the Pacific Climate Change Science Program which is published by the Australian government.
Are the rising sea levels affecting the community?

Yes! There are stand-alone provisions for assistance to the small island states and some other countries that are the least developed. These provisions are listed in the COP21 as outcomes that provide for loss and damages resulting from the climate change. As I stated before, An ambitious project is under way to limit the rise of temperatures by 1.5 degrees by the end of the century.
You have been most amazing tonight! Thank you for your information!
Your welcome!

Can you tell me information on Yukon?

Can you tell me more about the Yukon's demographics?

That is sad to hear. Can you tell me about the geography?

There is a mountain within Liberia that is highest point in the country, Mount Wuteve at 1440 m above sea level. This mountain is in the northwestern region of Liberia and a part of the west African mountains and the Guinea Highlands.
That sounds lovely. Any other geography tidbits?

As I stated earlier Liberia is located on the west coast of Africa, which allows it to border the North Atlantic Ocean on the countries southwestern side. Also there is a mountain that is higher that Mount Wuteve, Mount Nimba at 1752 m above sea level, but this mountain is not completely in Liberia as is Wuteve.
Interesting! Can you tell me about the culture?
Liberia has a unique tradition that is imported from the United States of baking, they are the only ones from west Africa.
That is interesting! Can you tell me more about that?

I apologize but i do not have further information on the tradition of baking imported from the United States. I can let you know that Liberia is one of only three countries that have not started using the metric system, one of the other countries being the united states.
We aren't the only one! Thanks so much for all the information.
You are very welcome, thank you.

messages.message: Hello what can you tell me about Alaska?
Alaska is a US state in the far northwest. It does not border any other state, but borders Canada. It was the 49th state.
What can you tell me about their demographics?
Alaska is the largest US state by area and the tenth most wealthiest. It has the lowest population density of all states with about half of the population living in the Anchorage metro area.
Interesting. What else can you tell me about Alaska's demographics?
As of the 2010 census, Alaska had a population of about 710,000.
Do you have any information about Alaska's history?
Sure! The US bought the Alaskan territory from Russia in 1867 for about $0.02 an acre. The Russians never successfully colonized the area so it was never profitable for them.
What else can you tell me?
The Aleut word for Alaska means "the great land".
Thank you so much for your help.
You are welcome.
Good evening, I have a test on South Africa coming up. Can you help me with information?
Absolutely! The Republic of South Africa, commonly referred to as just South Africa, is a country located on the continent of Africa. It is the southernmost country on the continent.
This is great location information! Do you have access to any information about politics and government?
Yes! South Africa legalized same-sex marriage in November of 2006. It was the first country in Africa to do so.
Oh wow I did not know that at all. I did not know they had legalized same sex marriage. Do you have more political and government facts?
I do. South Africa was one of the founding members of the African Union. Additionally, the country was a founding member of the United Nations.
I think it is great that so many different countries make up the UN. This is great information. One more political fact?
Sure. The country is also a founding member of the African Union's NEPAD (New Partnership for Africa's Development).
I also need to learn about the culture in South Africa. Do you have access to these facts?
Unfortunately, I currently don't have much information regarding that. However, I can tell you that South Africa has the twelfth largest Jewish community in the world!
That is alright. Any facts on the topics are great. Thank you!

Of course. I just received some information regarding a cultural piece from the country: In 2015, The Endless River, a South African film by Oliver Hermanus, became the first ever film from the country to be selected for the Venice Film Festival!
That is awesome. I love that the film was in a festival that is a huge achievement. Any other fun facts for the road?
Sure! The South African government currently has hardwood trees under government protection. A few of those trees are real yellowwood, stinkwood, and South African black ironwood.
Thank you so very much! For all of your help
You're welcome. Have a great night.

Sure. Tibet is a region covering the Tibetan Plateau in modern-day China. It's the traditional homeland of groups like the Monpa, Qiang, Sherpa & Lhoba people. Tibet is the highest region on earth, with an elevation of 5000 meters. The highest elevation there is Mt Everest, that rises to a height of 29,029 ft above sea level.
Interesting! Can you tell me anything about the Culture?

Yes. The music of Tibet reflects the cultural heritage of the trans-Himalayan region, centered in Tibet but also known wherever ethnic Tibetan groups are found in India, Bhutan, Nepal and further abroad.

The first Christians documented to have reached Tibet were the Nestorians, of whom various remains and inscriptions have been found in in Tibet. Boen is the indigenous religion of Tibet, but has almost entirely been replaced by Tibetan Buddhism. Tibetan music is religious, reflecting the profound influence of Tibetan Buddhism on the culture.

The Tibetan government is called the Ganden Phodrang. There is a written plan called the "Twenty Nine Regulations for Better Government in Tibet". After 1959, a group Tibetan Muslims made a case for Indian nationality based on their historic roots to Kashmir and the Indian government, which declared all Tibetan Muslims Indian citizens.

messages.message: Hi there, I'd like to learn more about Africa.
Sure. Comprising about one-fifth of the land on Earth, Africa is the world's second-largest continent. It is thought to be where the first humans evolved.
I see! What about the demographics of Africa?
The Arabic language and Islam were introduced to North Africa by the Arabs who arrived in the 7th century.
Interesting. I didn't know the language arrived that early. Do you have any other demographic information?

There are three main indigenous groups in North Africa: Nilo-Saharan-speaking peoples in the East, Egyptians in the northeast, and Berbers in the northwest. There are also Nilotic groups in South Sudan and East Africa, as well as mixed Swahili people on the Swahili Coast and a few remaining indigenous Khiosan and Pygmy peoples in southern and central Africa.
Wow, interesting! I'd never heard of Berbers before. I'd like to know more about Africa's culture now.
North African music and dance show definite Arab influences, while in South Africa, Western colonization has made Western influences apparent.
Cool. Any other things about the culture?
Modern music includes the dance rhythms of soukous (a music genre) dominated by the music of the Democratic Republic of Congo, as well as the highly complex choral singing of southern Africa.
Very cool. I'll have to look up soukous music later. Thanks for the helpful info!
You're welcome, have a great day!
