messages.message: Hello, I'd like to learn about Malta history.
Hello, Malta is an island in Europe which is near the center of the Mediterranean Sea. What would you like to learn about this country?
Are there any volcanoes in Malta?

I do not have that information but as for other geographical facts, Malta is an archipelago that is about 80 km south of Italy. Its 3 largest islands, Malta, Gozo, and Comino are the only ones inhabited.
Those are good geographical facts. Can you tell me something about the history of Malta?
Yes, in July of 1990, Malta applied to join the European Union.
Is there anything you can tell me about ancient history of Malta?
Yes, between 1530 and 1798, the Order of Saint John were the rulers of Malta and Gozo.
That satisfies my curiosity about history. Do you have a fun fact about Malta?
Yes, did you know Malta International Airport is the only airport for the Maltese islands?
Great information! Thank you for the fun facts about Malta especially about its history and goegraphy.
No problem. Glad I was able to help!
Hi, I would like to learn about Benin's culture.

Benin, officially called the Republic of Benin, is a country in Africa, The official language is French but Fon and Yoruba are also commonly spoken. The largest religious group in Benin is Roman Catholicism. France took over this country after slavery ended.
I'm interested in Benin's Etymology. Can you help me out with that?
Sure. Did you know the country of Benin has no connection to Benin City in modern Nigeria, no to the Benin bronzes.
Can you tell me about Benin's science and technology please?
Unfortunately, l do not have that information. I can tell you more about its etymology. The form "Benin" is the result of a Portuguese corruption of the city of Ubinu which is now Benin City.
I'm really curious about their education and religion. Would you mind giving me some information about them?
Following the largest religious group Roman Catholicism, is Islam, Vodun, and Protestantism. Unfortunately, I have no information about its health.
Can you tell me about the history of Benin?
In 1980, Kerekou converted to Islam and changed his name to Ahmed.
Do you have demography information about Benin as well?
Benin is a member of the Organization for the Harmonization of Business Law in Africa.
Can you tell me about the health of Benin?
Sorry, I do not have that information. But did you know the political system is derived from the 1990 Constitution of Benin and the Subsequent to democracy in 1991?
Thank you!
You're welcome.
Hello! I would like to learn about Benin's economy.
Yes, Benin is a member of OHADA organization for Harmonization of Business Law in Africa.
Can you expand on that?
Im sorry but thats all the information i have on the OHADA. Another ecconomy fact is that Benin is connected to its 5 neighboring countries by a 2 lane asphalt road.
That's okay! Do you have anything on the transportation of Benin?
Well most of Benins people live on the small southern coastline of Bight and its largest religious group is roman catholic.
Please tell me more about the transportation.
Their highways will stretch west to seven other West African states after its construction is complete.
Thank for you all your help!
Of course, have a nice day!
Hi. What can you tell me about Romania?
Hello! Romania is on the north of the Balkan Peninsula.
Interesting. What are the demographics?
The capital of Romania is Bucharest which is also the largest with a population of 1.8 million as of 2011.
Good to know. What about the governance of Romania?
Romania is divided into 41 different counties called judetse.
Wow. Any other interesting facts?
Romania entered World War II in June 1941 after the Germans invaded the Soviet Union.
Thanks so much for your help.
You are welcome. Is there anything else i can help you with?
I'm interested in learning about Lithuania.
Hello! Lithuania is on the northern side of Europe by the Baltic Sea. About 3 million people live there. Is there anything in particular you'd like to know about it?
I'm curious about the Economy in Lithuania.
Ok, Lithuania is considered high-income economy by the World Bank. Most of the foreign investments comes from EU countries.
What is the EU?
It's the European Union, a political and economic union of 28 states that are located primarily in Europe.
What is the EU?
Again, it's the European Union, a political and economic union of 28 states that are located primarily in Europe.
Is Lithuania a member of the EU?
Yes they are. During the 2nd half of 2013, they assumed the role of the presidency of the EU.
Hi, can you let me know what it's like in Colombia?
Hi! So that I can get you the right information, would you like to know about their history?
I heard the amazon basin is pretty remarkable. I would like to know more about that if you don't mind.

The Amazon Basin is one of the four main drainage systems in the country. Along with the Pacific drain, the Caribbean drain, and the Orinoco Basin. Colombia actually went to war with Peru because of a dispute over territory of the Amazon basin.
Oh wow! I bet that war was pretty intense! Can you tell me more of Columbia's history?

Sure! In 1921 the United States paid Colombia $25,000,000 as a gesture to rectify President Roosevelt's role in the creation of Panama. Colombia did agree to recognize Panama under the terms of the Thomson-Urrutia Treaty.
Interesting! Where exactly is Columbia located?
It is located in South America. It is bordered by: Venezuela, Brazil, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama. It is also the only South American country that has coasts on both the Pacific and Atlantic oceans!
Cool, is Columbia a prosperous country? How is the economy doing there?
Unfortunately, that information is not available at this time. However, i can tell you that they do obtain a pretty decent portion of their revenue from wood exports.
Alright, thank you!
You're very welcome!
What do you know about the geography of France?

The vast majority of France's population and territory is situated in Western Europe and is called Metropolitan France. It extends from the Mediterranean Sea to the English Channel and the North Sea, and frome the Rhine to the Atlantic Ocean.
What about the Etymology there?
It was linked to the word Frank or Free thus the name France.
Very Interesting, how about the geography of the region?
France is often referred to as "L'Hexagone" or The Hexagon because of the shape of its territory.
Wow, that is really cool. what more can you tell me of the geography there?
France has an extensive river system such as the Siene, Loire, Garrone and Rhone which run across 62% of the metropolitan territory.
That is really exciting, Thanks for your help.
You're welcome.
Hi, can you tell me about Manila?

Manila is the capital of the Philippines. It is one of the largest cities in the Philippines. Manila is on the biggest island of the Philippines, Luzon. After the 1898 Battle of Manila, Spain ceded Manila to the United Sates.
Interesting. Can you tell me about the law and government there?

The historic Walled City is located here, along with Manila Cathedral and San Agustin Church, a UNESCO World Heritage Site District VI (2007 population: 295,245) covers Pandacan, San Miguel, Santa Ana, Santa Mesa and portion of Paco. Manila has the most number of barangays in the Philippines.
Can you tell me anything else about their government and law?

Santa Ana district is known for its 18th Century Santa Ana Church and historic ancestral houses. The historic Walled City is administered by the Intramuros Administration, while the Manila North Harbor is managed by the Philippine Ports Authority.
Huh, interesting. Can you tell me about the etymology? I'm curious about where the word comes from.
Maynila, the Filipino name for the city, comes from the phrase may-nila, which translates to where indigo is found.
That's cool. Thank you so much for all the information. I've learned a lot!
You're welcome! Have a nice day!
Hello, I would like to learn about Lesotho
Lesotho is a small country in southern Africa. It's population is about 1.8 million. The capital city is Maseru.
Could you tell me more about its culture.
Sure, the National Anthem of Lesotho is "Lesotho Fatse La Bo-ntata Rona" which translates as "Lesotho Land of Our Fore-Fathers"
Do they have any tribes in Lesotho?
Yes, due to Lesotho being an unified nation even after British colonial rule the ethnic makeup of the nation is very homogeneous, almost 99.7 percent of people are identified as Basotho.
Speaking of British colonial rule, I was interested in learning more about security in Lesotho.
The Lesotho Mounted Police Service (LMPS) is established under article 147 of national Constitution, and are incharge of the maintenance of law and order.
Do they have any type of military there?

They have, The Lesotho Defense Force (LDF) is the military of Kingdom of Lesotho, consist of 3,000 personnel in tasked of maintaining internal security, territorial integrity, and defending the constitutuion.
Thank you for all the information! You've been very helpful!
You're welcome.
Can you tell me about etymology in Glasgow?
Glasgow is the biggest city in Scotland it is on the banks of the River Clyde
Do you have information on major incidents and tragedies in Glasgow?
In 2007 there was a terrorist attack at the Glasgow airport
Do you have more information?
It was the first terrorist attack in Scotland since 1988. It involved a green Jeep and explosives
Do you have information more etymology information?
The name is derived from the middle Gaelic cognate, which was meant green basin or green valley
Can I help you with anything else?
Can you help me learn about Azerbaijan?
Sure would you like to know about their History?
Yes please!
Some linguists have also stated that the Tati dialects of Iranian Azerbaijan and the Republic of Azerbaijan, like those spoken by the Tats, are descended from Old Azeri
Could you tell me more?
Iran was forced to cede its Caucasian territories to Russia in the 19th century, which thus included the territory of the modern day Azerbaijan Repunlic.
That's very interesting! Can you also tell me about their geography?
Republic of Azerbaijan is a country in the South Caucasus region of Eurasia. It is next to Russia in the north, George, Armenia, in the west, Iran in the South and Caspian Sean on the East.
Can you tell me more?
Azerbaijan also holds observer status in the World Trade Organization
That's very interesting! Thank you for the information
Your very welcome.
Hi! What can you tell me about Bhutan?

Ceratinly. Bhutan,also known as Kingdom of Bhutan, is a small country located in the Himalaya mountains in South Asia. Bhutan was founded in 1644 by Shabdrung Namgyei. The official language is Dzongha and the population size is about 700,000..
How cool! Can you tell me anything about their Biodiversity?
I'm sorry, i don't have any information on their biodiversity. Would you like to know more about their history?
At the moment i an interested in their Demographics. Can you tell me anything about that?

As of 2016, male life expectancy was 69.9 and 70.1 for females, according to the World Bank. It is estimated that between 2/3 and 3/4 of the Bhutan population follow the state religion, which is Varjrayan Bhuddism.
Neat! Is there anything else interesting you can tell me?

Bhutan was closed to the outside world up until 1974.Now, people are allowed to visit the country, but only in small numbers. There is only 1 airport their main export is hydroelectricity, which is sold in India.
Cool! Anything i need to know?
Would you like to know more about their economy?
sure
Bhutan's economy is dependent on forestry, agriculture, the sale of hydroelectricity to India, and tourism.
Neat! Thanks for all the help. Have a good day.
You're welcome.
Hi, could you tell me about Italy?
Sure, would you like to know about its geography?
That would be perfect.

Italy is a country in south Europe and a member of the European Union. It's absolute location is 35 deg and 47 deg N and 6 deg and 19 deg E. It is bordered by France, Switzerland, Austria and Slovenia to the north.
Do you know anything about the Demographics?
Before 1861, Italy was made up of smaller kingdoms and city-states. The country's capital is Rome.
That's fascinating. Is there anything else?
Italy has a very low rate of adult obesity compared to other European countries. Mediterranean diet is considered to have several health benefits.
That's amazing. Do you have any other interesting facts about Italy?

The Mediterranean diet forms the basis of Italian cuisine that is rich in pasta, fish, fruits and vegetables. Their dishes are extremely simple and varied with many dishes with having only four to eight ingredients.
Thank you so much.
You're welcome.
Hello. What can you tell me about Vanuatu?
Vanuatu is a country in the Pacific Ocean. The country was a colony of England and France until they gained freedom in 1980.
I didn't know that. What's the population like?
There are about 202000 people there and one third of the population are Presbyterian and belong to the Church there.
Interesting. What else can you tell me about their church?

One of the founding fathers who later became Prime Minister was a priest named Father Walter Lini. He was a member of the first political party established in early 1970 called the New Hebrides National Party.
Sounds interesting. Can you tell me how they gained their freedom in 1980?
The Vanua'kau Pati pushed for freedom since 1974 and they gained their freedom during the brief Coconut War.
Wow! I have never heard of a Coconut War. Are there any details available on that war?
Unfortunately I do not have any further information about the Coconut War.
Okay. Thanks for all of the information.
You are very welcome!

messages.message: What can you tell me about the infrastructure in Mongolia?
Mongolia's national air carrier is Mongolian Airlines. It operates international flights. Domestic and regional routes are operated by Aero Mongolia and Hunnu Airlines.
Oh wow! What else can you tell me about it?
Mongolian national universities are all spin-offs from the National University of Science and technology.
And what could you tell me about the government and politics there?
The parliamentary republic is is the political system of Mongolia.
Ok. What other information do you have?
The People's Party formed the government from 1921-1996 and from 2000-2004.
Whats the peoples party?
The People's Party is also knows as the People's Revolutionary Party. They were an almost equal partner of the Democratic Party between 12004-2006.
Oh neat! I didnt know that! Thank you! What else could you tell me about government or politics there?
On May 24, 2009, Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj was elected as president. He was a two time former member of the Democratic Party.
Wow! Youve been so great today! Thank you so much!
Absolutely, happy to help. Take care.
Hello, I want to learn about Long Island.

Sure. It is a large island in New York state and is the longest and largest island in the mainland United States. It is composed of four counties, and two of those counties, Queens and Brooklyn in the west are also boroughs of New York City.
Interesting. Can you tell me about their public transportation?
Being such a large populous island with several airports connecting the island with the rest of the world, there are several hundred transportation companies that service the area.
Can you tell me about some of the services they have?

The major transportation services they have include JFK airport, LaGuardia Airport, numerous smaller airports, the Long Island Rail Road, and the New York City subway, as well as bus routes from MTA regional bus operations.
What areas do the MTA run?
It is a huge operations that run to virtually all areas of the island and they move more than 2.6 billion bus and rail customers a year.
Wow that is awesome. Now I want to learn about the history. Do you have any information about the early history in Long Island?
Yes. The first settlement on the island was in 1640, when Southold was established by the Rev. John Youngs and settlers from New Haven, Connecticut.
Do you have anymore facts on Rev. John Youngs?
No more information on him, but an interesting fact is that Adrien Black, in 1615, is credited as the first European to determine that both Manhattan and Long Islands were actually islands.
Oh wow, ok. Is there any history in the 21st century?
Only that 20% of Long Islanders currently commute to jobs in Manhattan.
Well, thanks for all the information. Have a nice day.
You are welcome!
Hello I'd like to learn more about Jersey

Jesey is an island off the northwest coast of France. Jersey is called a "bailiwick" because the person who is the head of law for the island is callthe "Bailiff" Over 97,000 live on the main island. Thirty percent of them live in its only town, Saint Helier.
Very interesting! What can you tell me about their demographics?
Approximately half of the island's population was born in Jersey. Some Jersey born folks identify as British.
Neat, anything else you know about their demographics?
The people of Jersey are called Islanders, or individually Jerseymen or Jerseywomen.
I didn't know that! What do you know about their emergency services?
Emergency services are provided the States of New Jersey Police with the support of the Honorary Police as necessary.
Awesome, any other cool facts you know?
Until the 19th century, Jerriais, a form of Norman was the language of the island. The island is particularly famous for a festival called The Battle of the Flowers".
I didn't know that, thank you for all the wonderful infomation
You are welcome.

no problem. on its part the government of bhutan agrees to be guided by the advice of the government of india in regard to its external relations. the revised treaty now states in keeping with the abiding ties of close friendship and cooperation between bhutan and india, the government of the kingdom of bhutan and the government of the republic of india shall cooperate closely with each other on issues relating to their national interests

In West Bengal its one of the 19th districts receiving funds from the Backward Regions Grant Fund.

Thiruvanantgapuran is the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala

When the state of Kerala was formed on November 1 1956, Thiruvananthapuram became its capital

The functions of the Municipal Coporation are managed by seven departments - engineering, health, general administration, council, accounts, and revenue

no sorry i do not have any other facts about the health department

Good M, Turkmenistan is a country in so central Asia

The official name is the Republic of Turkmenistan since its independence for the Soviet Union in 1991

It does not have a Russian seminary. Baha i Faith history in Turkmenistan goes back as far as the regelion

Hello. Where is Brunei?
Hi! It is a country in Southeast Asia, North of Malaysia.
Can you tell me of their culture?

Sure, here is a couple of facts. Their top two football leagues are the Brunei Super League and the Brunei Premier League. The culture of Brunei is most Malay(reflecting it's ethnicity) with heavy influences from Islam.
Wow. Any more cultural facts you can share with me?
Sure, remember the football leagues we were discussing? They joined FIFA in 1969, but has had no success.
Do you know anything about the associated etomology?

cool. Will you please tell me another fun fact regarding etymology?

After World War II, a new government was formed in Brunei under they close eye of the British Military Administration.

Hi tell me about South Dakota.
Hello, well South Dakota became a state in 1889 and Pierre is the capital.
Good to know. Do you know anything about sports in South Dakota?
Its home to the 478 mile cycling event Tour De Dakota and annual Sturgis Motorcycle Rally.
Do you know when the event happens? Or you can tell me another fact about sports there.
Sturgis is every year and is one of the largest tourist events in the state but I dont have the information on when the cycling event happens.
Ok. I would like to learn about media in South Dakota. Do you know any?
Its largest news paper Sioux Falls Argus Leader has a sunday circulation of over 63k people .
Do you have any other facts about the news paper? Do you know when it started publishing by chance?
I dont have any other info on the paper but the states first television station KELO-TV began in Sioux Falls 1953.

messages.message: Hello! I am doing a paper on Afghanistan, can you help with information?
Afghanistan is a country located in Central Asia and South Asia. Kabul is the capital city of Afghanistan.

Sure I can, Afghanistan's culture is influenced by Islam. There are two official languages; Dari and Pashto.
I did not know that! COuld you possibly tell me more about the Culture there?
Sure, Nearly All Afghan follow Islamic traditions, celebrate the same holiday, dress the same, consume the same food, listen to the same music and multi-lingual to a certain extent.
Very cool! Do you happen to have any information on the Governance?

Yes, one instrument of Afghan governance is the Ioya jirga (grand assembly), a Pashtun consultative meeting that is mainly organized for choosing a new head of state, adopting new constitution or settle a national or regional issue such as war. '
Neat! Is there anything else I should know?
The Afghan Armed Forces are under the MInistry of Defense which includes the Afghan Air Force and Afghan National Army.
Cool! Thanks for all the help! Have a good day!
You're welcome
what can you tell me about ivory coast?
Officially the Republic of Cote d"lvoire, is a country in West Africa.
thanks can you tell me about its culture?
The traditional cuisine of Ivory Coast is very similar to that of neighboring countries in West Africa in its reliance on grains and tubers.
thanks what else can you tell me about culture?
The national football team has played in the World Cup three times, in Germany 2006, in south Africa 2010, and Brazil in 2014.
nice what can you tell me about politics?
WASH focuses on safe drinkable water, hygiene, and proper sanitation.
anything else you can tell me about politics?
In 2015, the United Nations engineered the Sustainable Development Goals (replacing the Millennium Development Goals.
thank u that is all i need today

Hi there, can you tell me about the culture of Samoa?
Sure, it is a country in the Pacific Ocean. It became independent from New Zealand in 1962.
Interesting. What about the people of Samoa?
They speak Samoan and English.
Huh, I didn't know they were bilingual. What is the education like in Samoa?
Education is effective, 99% of Samoans are literate.
Wow, that's a really high literacy rate. Are there any universities in Samoa?
There is 1 national college, University of Samoa.

No, I have no other information on education.
Ok, thanks for all of your help!

Hello! I'd like to learn about Lestho

What kind of Politics does it have?
Interestingly, Lesotho is surrounded by South Africa, so its politics are generally affected by the politics of South Africa.

You may be surprised to know that Lesotho has a Senate, its upper house of parliament, with 22 hereditary members, as well as 11 members chosen by Lesotho's king (who receives help to chose appointees from the country's prime minister).
I do find that interesting! Any more interesting facts you can share?
Yes, in fact, the title of the national anthem of Lesotho translates to "Lesotho, Land of Our Fore-Fathers".
That's really cool! Thank you! I've learned alot and appreciate you helping me to learn it!
No problem! Happy to help!

There were Polish communities in Milwaukee, mostly on the east side

The Germans are an important component of life in Milwaukee especially after the civil war

Hi what can you tell me about Iowa? Specifically its history
Iowa became the 29th state on December 28, 1846 when signed into union by President Polk.
What is the population of Iowa?
The population of Iowa has increased faster than the US as a whole. In 2018, the population was just over 3 million.
TY can you tell me if they have a mass tarnsit system?
The state has several small airports including Davenport and Dubuque.

Iowa is one of the country’s top producers of pork, soybeans, corn and eggs. Farmers in Iowa also lead the turkey and dairy industries.

A few! Iowa is home to the beautiful Maquoketa Caves State Park, Adventureland Theme park, and Amana Colonies - a German village with shops and dining.

Hello! Can you tell me about Korea?

Yes. The Korean peninsula is in northeast Asia. It is currently split into 2 countries after a civil war and is heavily populated. North and South Korea has 76 million people combined. Most of the population 51 million are in South Korea.
Cool! Can you tell me about its demographics, please?
The number of foreigners living in Korea is on a steady increase since the late 20th century, especially South Korea where more than 1 million foreigners live.
Wow, that's a lot of people. Can you tell me anything else of their demographics?
Yes, some of the Korean born ethnic groups have developed their own communities, like the ethnic Chinese and Japanese.
Interesting. Can you tell me about the etymology now? I'm curious about the origins of the word Mongolia.
Yes, a former King, Taejo, named it for the earlier Kojoseon, who ruled norther Korea from its legendary prehistory until their conquest in 108 by China's Han Empire
I didn't know that! Is there any other interesting facts about Mongolia you can tell me?
I don't have any information about Mongolia, but can I can give you history facts on Korea. It was annexed by Japan on August 29, 1910 following an imposed Japan-Korean Treaty.
I see. Thank you for your time! I've learned quite a bit!
You are welcome. Have a nice day!
Hello, I would like to learn about Bangladesh.
Bangladesh is a country in South Asia. It is next to the North-east Indian provincial regions of India, which converges with Southeast Asia to the east.
What about the demographics in Bangladesh?
Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh number at around 1, making Bangladesh one of the countries with the largest refugee population in the world.
interesting, please tell me more about the demographics in Bangladesh.
Sure! The only information I have about their demographics is that Urdu has a significant heritage in Bangladesh.
What about the economy in Bangladesh?
Bangladesh has a rail network operated by state-owned Bangladesh Railway.
Do you have information about the technology industry?
I'm sorry, but I don't have much information about their technology industry, but Bangladesh is located in the Indomalaya ecozone.
Do you have any other info?
In 2005, Bangladesh was the world's largest cement producer, an industry dependent on limestone imports.

messages.message: Hello! Can you tell me anything about South Australia?
South Australia is one of the six states of Australia. Would you like to learn more about its history?
I would actually! Please share!

South Australia was the second Australian state to be settled by free colonists. The land which now forms the state of South Australia was claimed for Britain in 1788 as part of the colony of New South Wales.
Interesting! Do you happen to have more on their History?
It took more than forty years before any serious proposal to establish settlements in the south-western portion of New South Wales were put forward.
Neat! Can you tell me anything about the Demographics?
I don't have that information on hand. What I can share is that the current flag of South Australia was adopted on January 13th, 1904 and is a British blue ensign defaced with the state badge.
Cool! Is there anything else I should know?
You might be interested to hear that South Australia has a container port at Port Adelaide.
Amazing! Thank you for all your help! Have a good day!
You're welcome!
I'd like to learn about Islamabad
Sure! Islamabad ("abode of Islam") is the Federal capital city of Pakistan, and is in the Pothohar Plateau in the northwest of the country. Islamabad Town is also a town in Jammu and Kashmir.
Can you tell me about the culture there?
Islamabad is home to many migrants from other regions of Pakistan and has a cultural and religious diversity of considerable antiquity.
Interesting. What else can you tell me?

Islamabad has attracted people all over Pakistan, making it one of the most cosmopolitan and urbanised cities of Pakistan. The Lok Virsa Museum in Islamabad preserves a wide variety of expressions of olk and traditional cultural legacy of Pakistan.
And can you tell me about the economy?

I'm interested in politics. Who is the leader of Azerbaijan?
Azerbaijan is an active member of NATO's Partnership for Peace program. Llham Aliyev has been in power since 2003. He succeeded his father. They have a 7 year election term.
That is very interesting. Who was Llham Aliyev's father?
His name was Heydar Aliyev. That's a mouthful. :)
How long was Heydar Aliyev the leader of Azerbaijan?
He served from 1993 to 2003. In recent years, a large number of journalists, bloggers, lawyers, and human rights activists were jailed for their criticism of the President and the government.
Very interesting. How many people have been jailed in Azerbaijan for criticizing the President?
I'm sorry I don't have that information. Is there anything else that you would like to know about the country?
I learned very interesting information. Thank you for teaching me about Azerbaijan!
You are welcome. Have a good day.
Hello: Will you please share some basic facts about Tajikistan, such as the current population, physical location.
Tajikistan is a country in Central Asia. The capital is Dushanbe. The official language is Tajik, which is a dialect of Farsi (Persian). Approximately 98% of the population is Muslim.
So interesting! Do you have any additional details regarding the demographics of Tajikistan?
Tajiks who speak Tajik are the main ethnic group. There are fairly large minorities of Uzbeks and Russians but due to emigration their numbers are declining.
It sounds like the majority of the population is Muslim? What is the political structure?
Yes, around 98%. I don't have much information on the politics of Tajikistan at the moment, but I can tell you they are a member of the Commonwealth of Independent States, the CIS.
Thank you. Switching gears, do you have any information on the etymology of Tajikistan
I do, actually. Tajikistan means "the land of Tajiks." Who would've guessed? :)
What have you found on the culture ?

Not much, I apologize. I can tell you that despite Tajikistan's poverty, it has a high rate of literacy due to the old Soviet system of free education. Approximately 99.5% of the population can read and write!
That is so unusual that a population with a high in poverty has a high literacy rate. . Do you have any fun or interesting facts you've learned during your research?
The Dushanbe Tea House, created by Tajikistan artists, was presented in 1988 as a gift to the city of Boulder, Colorado. I found that kind of interesting!
That is interesting! Thank you for all of th good information, have a good day.
You're welcome. Have a great day!
What can you tell me about Zambia's history?
Well the TanZam Road was its major export trail until the completion of the railway system.
Can you tell me more?
In 1964 Northern Rhodesia became the Republic of Zambia with Kenneth Kaunda as the president .
I didn't know that. What can you tell me about Zambia's economy?
Sorry i dont have any information on its economy at this point but Zambia became independent from the UK in 1964.
That's okay, can you give me more interesting facts?
Yes, i found it interesting that they have about 13000 Indians residing in Zambia.
Great information thank you!
No problem, have a nice day!
I'd like to about New York City?
New York City is the biggest city in the United States.
What areas make up New York City?
New York City is made up of five boroughs.
I'd like to know about more about the boroughs and the combined population.
New York City is home to more than 3.2 million residents born outside the United states.
Okay can you give me some geographical information on New York City?
New York City is home to Fort Hamilton.
Are there any interesting fun facts about New York City you can share?
Pelham Bay Park is the largest park in New York City.
Thanks!
You're welcome.

messages.message: Hello. Can I get the etymology of the great Northwest Territories?
Sure! The Northwest Territories are in northern Canada. It has a population of 44,541 and it is 1,171,918 square kilometers.
Wow! That's huge! Do you have any information about their culture?
Yes! Issues in the Northwest Territories include the fate of the Dene who, were employed to carry uranium that was radioactive through the mines of Great Bear Lake.
That doesn't good, sounds like a health hazard. Do they have any mountains or nice lakes in the Northwest Territories?

It sure does! They have a nice national park called Aulavik National Park in the northern part of the Northern Territories. They also have a few rivers which include Mackenzie River and Nahanni River.
Sounds amazing. Do they have any tribes there?
The Indigenous peoples in the Northwest Territories include the Inuit and Metis .
Do they ever have any festivals there?

Absolutely, Some of the festivals that are in the region are the Great Northern Arts Festival, the Snowking Winter Festival, Rockin on the Rocks, and a music festival in Yellowknife called Folk on the Rocks.
That's awesome! Thank you.
Your Welcome!
Hello, I'm seeking information about South Australia
Sure, what would you like to know?
I would like first to know about the education system there?
Sure, the largest public provider of vocational education is called TAFE.
Anything else you know about the TAFE?
It is made up of colleges throughout the state of South Africa.
Nice! What about the transport system there?
It is pretty limited, especially at Adelaide which is the capital South Australia.
Any fun or interesting fact about South Australia that you'd like to share with me?
Soccer in South Australia is represented by Adelaide United!
Cool. Thank you for all the info you offered!
No problem
Hi, I'd like to learn about Thailand.

Hello. Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand, is a country in Southeast Asia. Its neighbors are Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar. The word Thai comes from the ethnic group in the center of Thailand.
Interesting. Could you please tell me a few things about education there?

I can tell you that Thailand was ranked 54th out of 56 countries globally for English proficiency, the second lowest in Asia. That's all I have access to right now for education but I can tell you Thailand was the most visited country in Southeast Asia in 2013.
Oh, that doesn't seem very good on English proficiency. Any idea why so many people visit Thailand? What's of interest there?
A lot of Asian tourists primarily visit Thailand for the capital city, Bangkok, because of its historical, natural and cultural sights.
I bet it's a very interesting place to visit. I'd like to learn about sports in Thailand now, please, if you have any information.

I do. There are a few popular sports in Thailand including the weightlifting and taekwondo and after their success in the last two summer Olympic Games, boxing is no longer the only medal option for Thailand.
Oh, I didn't know boxing or weightlifting even had a following in Thailand. Have they gotten many Olympic medals?

I am not sure how many medals have been won but I can let you know that their boxing incorporates kicks, punches, knees and elbow strikes in a ring with gloves similar to those ides in Western boxing and this has led to Thailand gaining medals at the Olympic Games.
That's very interesting. Sounds like a tough sport! You've been very helpful today, thanks for all the information!
You're welcome, thanks for chatting!
Hello! I would like to learn about Maharashtra Tourism
I have information on tourism. A part of Maharashtra have numerous nature reserve parks in Vidarbha.
What's the capital city of Maharashtra
The capital of Maharashtra is Mumbai which comes from the name of the original city named Mumbapuri. Did you know that the Pune is the cultural and educational capital.
Wow ! That's great information, I want to learn about economy of Maharashtra
Here's something about the economy. The FDI inflows into Maharashtra are 53.48 billion in US dollars. Would you like to know more about the economy?
Yes! Obsolutely!
Great! Maharashtra holds the leading position as the most industrialized state in India.
Nice! Do you have any information about Maharashtra attractions
Did you know they have cave monuments Ajanta and Ellora to name a few that are well known?
wow! Please tell me some other interesting facts about Maharashtra
Here is a interesting fact. Did you know Maharashtra is the ninth ranking Indian state in Human development index?
Wow, That's good enough information about Maharashtra! Thank You!
You welcome! Hope you enjoy your day!
Hello, can you tell me about Thrissur?
Thrissur is a district of Kerala in southwest India.
Could you inform me on its picture gallery?
The district is popular for Thissur Pooram which is a temple festival.
How about their culture?
It is known for having Hindu temples.
What language do they speak?
It is similar to other Indian countries, but most notably Hindi.
Any national cuisines?
Unfortunately, I don't have information on cuisine and diets. It is most likely traditionally Indian or ceremonial Hindu cuisine.
Is there anything you could tell me about their literature?
Institutions were set up to promote literature, music and arts in Kerala such as Kerala Lalita Kala Akademi, Kerala Sahitya Academy, Kerala Sangeetha Nadaka Academy, and the College of Fine Arts.
Thank you so much for all your help!
You're welcome.
Can you tell me about Liechtenstein and about its culture?
Of course! The Prince of Liechtenstein's private art collection is one of the best in the world. It is displayed at the Liechtenstein Museum in Vienna.
Can you tell me more please?
The largest museum is the Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein, which has a very important international modern and contemporary art collection.
Interesting. Now I want to know about its transport.
Ok, you got it. The nearest large airport to the country is about 80 miles away in Zurich, Switzerland.
Good to know! What else can you tell me about it?
The railways are run by the Austrian Federal Railways as part of the route between Austria and Switzerland.
Thank you for your info! You were very helpful. Good bye.
You are most welcome. Goodbye.
I would like to know about Kent.
Hi there! Would you like to know about the Local Media in Kent?
Yes please.
Kent has news papers that include the Kent Messenger, Kent on Saturday, Kent on Sunday, and the Kent and Sussex Courier.
Great! Can you tell me about the education?

Sure! Kent has 4 universities. Canterbury Christ Church University, University of Kent, University of Greenwich, and the University for the Creative Arts. Each university has campuses throughout Kent and other counties.
Thanks for the info!
You welcome. Glad to help!
Can you help me learn about Italy?
Of course! What would you like to know about Italy?
Let's start with their geography
Italy's location is in Southern Europe. Italy borders France, Switzerland, Austria, and Slovenia to the north.
Is there anything else you can tell me?
Influding the islands, Italy has a coastline and border of 7600 km on the Adriatic, Ionian,and Tyrrhenian seas.
Wow that is interesting! Can you help me with some demographic information?
As of the end of 2013, Italy had a population of 60,782,688. Its population density is one of the highest in Western Europe, but the distribution is uneven.
Oh wow, thank you for the information!
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you that is a lot of information
I'm glad to help.
Hi, I've never heard of Tiruchirappalli, where does that name come from?
Tiruchirappalli is a name in Tamil which means "town of respected Chira, "chira" is a name of a Jain monk.
Very interesting, what else can you tell me about etymology?
In Hindu mythology the name Tiruchirappalli came from a three-headed demon Trishira who meditated on Hindu god shiva near the present-day city to obtain favour from god.
Wow! A three-headed demon! What do you know about the economy in Tiruchirappalli?
From the late 1980's. synthetic gem industry was developed in the city, these gemstones are cut and polished in Tiruchirappalli district and Pudukottai district.
What more can you tell me about the synthetic gem industry in Tiruchirappalli?
Sure, in 1990 Indian government launch an increase in employment by boosting the production of diamonds.
The more diamonds the better! What else can you tell me about diamonds and the economy?
Aside from gem industry, other industry in Tiruchirappalli is the Trichy Distilleries and Chemicals Limited which was established in 1966 in the former Golden Rock Municipalities.
Cool! Can you tell me one more fun fact about etymology?
Sure, Tiruchirappalli is often called as Trichy or Tiruchi and British call this country as Trichinopoly.
Trichinopoly is a cool name I will be sure to remember that! Thanks for all the great information today!
You're welcome, have a great day!
I would like to learn more about Coimbatore
Ok, I can help you with that.
Can you tell me about its culture
The Coimbatore is based in Kongu Vellala Gounder community.
Can you also tell me about its Sports and recreation
This country is referred to as the India's motorsport hub and the Backyard of Indian Motorsports.
That's cool. I would like to learn more about its sports and recreation
I am sorry that information is not available.
Can you tell me more facts about Coimbatore
Sure, the economy is the largest non metro city for e commerce in South India.

messages.message: Good afternoon. Can you tell me where Burkina Faso is located?

Hello, Burkina Faso is located in West Africa, it was called Upper Volta before. They changed their name in 1984. This country was ruled by France until its Independence in 1960.However, French continues as their official language.
Can you tell me what countries are near and/or surround Burkina Faso?
Of course, Burkina Faso is next to Male, Niger, Benin, Togo, Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire. It is landlocked and it does not have any coast with an Ocean or Sea.
Thank you. That info was very helpful. I now have a better idea of exactly where Burkina Faso is located in Western Africa. Do you have any information about the climate there that you can share?

The climate in Burkina Faso is relatively a dry tropical savanna. The Sahel extends beyond the borders of Burkina Faso from the Horn of Africa to the Atlantic Ocean. It also borders the Sahara Desert from North until the fertile region of the Sudan to the south.
Any other interesting facts on the climate or geography of Burkina Faso you can share?

One interesting fact about Burkina Faso is one of the countries in West Africa that has the major number of Elephants. In addition, they have large predators like the Cheetah, the Caracal, the spotted Hyena, and the African Wild Dog making Burkina Faso one of the countries with most endangered species.
Wow. How very interesting. I had no idea the country had so many endangered species. What can you tell me about the government of the country?
In 1991 they established the constitution with a semi-presidential government. In that way, the Parliament was dissolved by a President of the Republic who must be elected for a term of 7 years.
Do you have any information on the type of government the country had between 1960, when they obtained their independence from France, & 1991 when constitution you referenced was established?

Not too much. In December of 1958 the republic of Upper Volta was established as self-governing colony within the French Community, but in August 1960 they gained full independence with the president Maurice Yameogo
Thank you. You provided me with some great information. Have a great day!
You welcome! have a great day!
Hi! Can you tell me anything about Mongolia?
Mongolia is located in Asia between China and Russia. The official language is Mongolian and spoken by 95% of the population.
Interesting! Can you tell me anything about Their Geography?

Mongolia is considered part of the Mongolian Plateau. The largest city is also the capital, Ulaanbaatar. The north and east of the country is very mountainous while the south is part of the Gobi Desert.
Neat! Can you tell me anymore?
The average annual temperature in Ulaanbaatar is -0.7 degrees Celsius (or 30.74 F) making it the coldest capital city in the world. The capital is also home to about 45% of the nations population.
Cool! Can you tell me anything about their Demographics?

There are approximately 2.8 million people living in Mongolia. Despite that it is the 18th largest country in the world by area the fact that is mainly rural makes in the lowest population dense country among all the independent countries in the world.
INteresting! Is there anything else I should know?
Mongolia is ranked as lower middle income economy and is economically depended on China and Russia. 90% of products exported from Mongolia go to China and Russia supplies 90% of their energy.
Neat! Thanks for all your help! Have a good day!
You are very welcome!
Hi, I would like to learn about the politics of New york state
The New York State Legislature is bicameral and consists of a state senate and state assembly.
Interesting any other information
The government of New York embodies the structure that was established by the New York State Constitution.
I see, what can you tell me about the transportation
New York has one of the most extensive and oldest transportation infrastructures in the country.
That's cool, what else can you tell me about the transportation
With the improvement of transportation, additional population migration to the west of New York was enabled.
Thanks for all the information
You're welcome.
what can u tell me about Sambalpur
Sure, Sambalpur is a city and Municipal Corporation and located in the western part of Odisha, and is one of the largest and oldest cities in the state.
Can you tell me about their education system
The Sambalpur chapter of Institute of Cost Accountants of India was set up in 2010 at Deheriali, near Fatak, Sambalpur, Odisha
How many colleges are located there

I'm not to sure but I do know that Sambalpur is famous for premier educational institutes like Sambalpur University, Veer Surendra Sai Insistence of Medical Sciences and Research, Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology, Gangadhar Meher University, Indian Institute of Management Sambalpir and Odisha State Open University.
ok thank you

Hello. Can you tell me about Kyrgyzstan?
Sure! Kyrgyzstan joined the UN and the OSCE in 1992. There are also four Uzbek enclaves with Kyrgyzstan.
Can you tell me more about its etymology?
Of course. Early in the 9th century, the Uyghurs dominated much of Central Asia, Mongolia and several parts of China and Russia.
Can you tell me more about transport in Kyrgyzstan?

Sure thing. The Chuy Valley and the Ferghana Valley were the endpoints of the Soviet Union's rail system in Kyrgyzstan. But the water transport exists only on the Issyk Kul Lake and has shrunk drastically since the end of the Soviet Union.
Interesting! Is rail the primary mode of transport now?
I do believe that it is. There are plans about extending the rail lines from Balykchy and/or from Osh in the south of China. But the costs of construction would be HUGE.
Thank you! Could you tell me the etymology of the name Kyrgyzstan? The origins of the name

Kyrgyzstan is sometimes known as Kirghizia. It was a socialist republic of Soviet Union but it became independent around 1991. It was a peaceful country in the 90's. Right now, different political groups are fighting for power. So far, three of the 75 elected members of Parliament have been murdered.
That's very interesting. What about the meaning of the name? Does it translate into something?

The definition of Kyrgyzstan is a mountainous country in central Asia, on the northwestern border of China; population approximately 5,900,000. The official language is Kyrgyz and Russian. The capital is Bishkek.
I mean the literal translation of the word Kyrgyzstan. Is there one?
I'm sorry. If there is a literal translation i can't find it.
Okay. Thank you for your help!
You are quite welcome.
Hello, I am seeking information on Svalbard please.
Sure. Svalbard is a group of islands in the Arctic Ocean. It is the most northern part of Norway.
What is the nature scene like there?
Svalbard has permafrost and tundra. In summer, the plants grow quickly during the midnight sun.
What about transport?
There are no roads in Svalbard. Instead, snowmobiles, aircraft, and boats serve as transport.
Oh wow, that is very interesting.
Svalbard Airport, Longyear, is the only airport offering air transport off the archipelago.
Do you have any information on the culture?
Unfortunately, I do not have information on Svalbard culture, but I do have facts on the Svalbard climate. 2016 was the warmest year on record with a mean temperature of 0.0 C.
That's to hot for me! I don't think I can handle it. Wel I thank you for all of your help.
You're welcome.

Nicaragua is a country in Central America. It is officially called the Republic of Nicaragua. It has a size of 129, 494 square kilometers. It is the largest country in Central America. It borders Honduras to the north and Costa Rica to the south.
Tell me more about the Demographics, please.

Although Nicaragua's health outcomes have improved over the past few decades with the efficient utilization of resources relative to other Central American nations, healthcare in Nicaragua still confronts challenges responding to its populations diverse healthcare needs.

I do not have access to that information at this time, but i can tell you this interesting fact about the history......In the last week of May thousands who accuse Mr. Ortega and his wife of acting like dictators joined in resuming anti-government rallies after attempted peace talks have remained unresolved.
okay, could you tell me about the History of Nicaragua?

In 1914, the Bryan-Chamorro Treaty was signed, giving the U.S control over a proposed canal through Nicaragua, as well as leases for potential canal defenses.

Sure thing. It is the capital of the United States.

Crime in Washington D.C. is concentrated in the areas associated with poverty and drug abuse, and gangs.

19% of residents were below the poverty level in 2005. It is higher than any state except Mississippi.

Since 1800 Washington D.C. is the home of Congress, the president, and the Supreme Court.

In 2005, 582,049 people lived in Washington D.C. according to the United States Census.

Sure, Mali is a landlocked country in West Africa, its border Algeria on th north Niger on the east, and Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire on the south. Let me know if there's anything, in particular, you'll kine to learn about Mali.
Can you give me information about the economy in Mali?

Of course, Mali is a member of the Organization for the Harmonization of Business Law in Africa. Mali is also connected with the French government by agreement since 1962 creating what is called BCEAO.

Today all seven countries of BCEAO including Mali are connected to French Central Bank.
DO you know any other fact about the agriculture or mining ?
No, I don't have any fact available on Agriculture or mining, but if there any other fact you'll like to know am happy to help.

There's no fact available, am happy to provide information about Society, geography, and history.

About 80% of Mali's population can communicate in Bambara, which serves as late 19th century.
Thank you very much for your time, all the information you provided me was very helpful

Hi! can you please provide me with information about Ecuador's history.
Hello! Sure, Ecuador is a small country located in South America. Ecuador used to be apart of the Spanish Empire, this was due to Spain being interested in finding gold in Ecuador.
That is very interesting. Do you have anymore information on Ecuador's history, possibly more recent events?

I do apologize, but I do not have any recent history facts. I can tell you that in The Guarantors of the Rio Protocol (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, and the United States of America) ruled that the border of the undelineated zone was to be set at the line of the Cordillera del Condor.
That is great information. What facts can you tell me about Ecuador's economy?
The public finance of Eduador consists of the Central Bank of Ecuador, the National Development Bank, and the State Bank.
How is the economy doing in Ecuador?
Ecuador's economy is the eighth largest in Latin America and experienced an average growth of 4.6% between 2000 and 2006.
Thank you this was very informative. Do you have any further information on Ecuador's economy or history?
Sure I do! In Ecuador's southern Andes Mountain region where the Maranon cuts across, Ecuador had de jure claims to an area it called Jaen de Bracamoros.
Thank you for all of this info, Have a great day.
Thank you and you as well!
Hi, I'd like to find out more about Burundi.

Certainly! Burundi, officially known as Republic of Burundi, is a small country located in Africa. It is one of the poorest countries in the world. Its capital is Bujumbura, and the official language is Kirundi and French.
With Burundi being poor, could you tell me more about its economy.
Burundi's currency is the Burundian Franc. They are a potential member of the Planned East African Federation and currently a part of the East African Community.
What's their major export or major businesses in the country?

Burundi telecommunications infrastructure is ranked 2nd to last in the World Economic Forum's Network Readiness Index (NRI), an indicator for determining the development level of a country's information and communication technology.
I see. I wonder how the internet there too. Anyway, how do you go around Burundi? What's the transport like?
The long-term plan for Burundi is to link the country via railway to Kigali, and then to Kampala and Kenya.
I see. Does Burundi have an airport?
Yes, the Bujumbura International Airport, is the only airport they have. It has a paved runway and has four airlines as of 2017. The city of Kigali has the most daily flight connections to Bujumbura.
You have been really helpful. Thank you for the information.
You are most welcome!

Indiana, is a state in U.S, with the capital and largest city named Indianapolis.
Do you know more about the demographics of the region?
I can tell you that Spanish, after the English language, is their second language that they use to communicate.
cool do you know any more infomation about the people in Indiana?
It is reported that German is the largest ancestry to be reported in Indiana, with up to 22.7% of the population reporting that ancestry in the Census.
do you know any other intersting facts about Indiana?

Well, did you also know that Evansville, Anderson, and Muncie are cities in Indiana that have had the steepest decline in population?

Andhra Pradesh is a state in the Republic of India. It is bigger than Burkina Faso but smaller than Ecuador. It largest city is Visakpatnam. Th official language is Teludu.

Is has a population of 75,727,00 according to 2001 census. The eastern boundary is a coastline along the Bay of Bengal. Divided into Andhra Pradesh and Telangana in 2004. Jnanpith Award holders from the state include Viswanatha Satyanarayana. The Telugu film culture known as Tollywood is the second-largest film industry in India next to Bollywood film industry.

Hyderabad was made the capital of the new state. Film producer D. Ramanaidu holds a Guinness World Record for the most films produced by a person.

Niue is an island country in the South Pacific that is situated between Tonga, Samoa and the Cook Islands.
What is the landscape like?
Coral reef surrounds the island, with the only major break in the reef being in the central western coast, close to the capital, Alofi.
Wow, that's incredible. What about their culture?
Most of the inhabitants of the island descend from Tonga, Samoa and Fiji.
Very interesting, thank you for such great info!
You are welcome.
Hello, I would like to learn more about Sudan.
Sudan is an African country, officially named The Republic of Sudan. It is located in northeast Africa.
Can you share information about their Government and Politics System?
Government forces and other militias allied with the government are unfortunately know to attack civilians in Darfur but also humanitarian workers. China is their largest supplier of weapons.

The legal system in Sudan is based on Islamic Sharia law. Some people are under the belief that these laws apply to even those non-Muslims in Sudan.

Sudan recognized the independence of South Sudan in 1956. The Abyei Area is still a disputed region between the two.
Do you have information about the Health System in Sudan?
I do not seem to have that information, but oil is Sudans main export with the production in the 2000s. The current population of Sudan is around 30 million people.

Sudan has extensive economic relations with China. In fact China obtains 10% of their oil supply from Sudan.

The most significant feature of Europe's terrain is the dichotomy between mountainous and highland Southern Europe and a vast, partially underwater, northern plain.

messages.message: Hi! Can you tell me about Chicago?

Chicago's Public Radio produces nationally aired programs such as PRI's 'This American Life' and NPR's 'Wait Wait...Don't tell me!'. Additionally, The Barack Obama Presidential Center will be housed at the University of Chicago in Hyde Park and will include both the Obama presidential library and the offices of the Obama Foundation. It's scheduled for completion in 2020

There is also Chicago Botanic Garden in Glencoe and the Brookfield Zoo in Brookfield.

Another interesting fact- The Chicago suburb of Oak Park was home to famous architect Frank Lloyd Wright. He designed The Robie House which is located near the University of Chicago. Also, the Southside neighborhood Hyde Park is home to former President Obama. In addition to famous people, Chicago is also home to several TV shows (and many more movies). messages.message: Tell me about Mumbai.

Hello. I would be happy to tell you about Mumbai. Mumbai was previously known as Bombay until 1996. It is located on a natural harbor on the west coast of India and is the capital city of Maharashtra state. It is India's largest city and one of the world's most populous cities with 14 million people. In fact, along with the neighboring cities of Navi Mumbai and Thane, it forms the world's 4th largest urban agglomeration with around 19.1 million people. Would you like more information on transportation in Mumbai?
Sure

Mumbai is served by two major ports, Mumbai Port Trust and Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust. The Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust lies just across the creek in Navi Mumbai. The Navi Mumbai Municipal Transport (NMMT) and Thane Municipal Transport (TMT) operate buses in Mumbai connecting the three together.
What's Mumbai transportation like?

Public buses cover almost all parts of the metropolis. Auto rickshaws are allowed to operate only in the suburban areas of Mumbai, while taxis are allowed to operate throughout Mumbai, though they generally operate in South Mumbai.
Cool, tell me about Mumbai's etymology?

Sure! As mentioned before, Mumbai was previously named Bombay. According to some sources, it was argued that Bombay was a corrupted English version of Mumbai and an unwanted legacy of British colonial rule. In 1996 it was renamed Mumbai. A resident of Mumbai is called a Mumbaikar in Marathi, in which the suffix 'kar' means a resident of.
Any other facts?

Sure, while the city is still referred to as Bombay by some of its residents and by Indians from other regions, mention of the city by a name other than Mumbai has been controversial. In fact, it has resulted in emotional outbursts by people, some of them ending violently. Here's a fun fact! Mumbai's first professional American Football franchise, the Mumbai Gladiators, played its first season in Pune in late 2012. Also the very first cricket test match in India was played in Mumbai at the Bombay Gymkhana.
Cool, how's the education there?

The primary education system is the largest urban primary education system in Asia. The MCGM operates 1,188 primary schools, educating 485,531 students in eight languages (Marathi, Hindi, Gujarati, Urdu, English, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada). The schools are affiliated with either of the following boards: Maharashtra State Board (MSBSHSE), The All-India Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), The National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), The Central Board for Secondary Education (CBSE), the International Baccalaureate (IB), The International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE).

Despite being Non-conformist, demographically uneven, and with Welsh being the native language, the nation was forced to adopt English-centric education in the 19th century due to state involvement. In 1907, the Welsh Department for the Board of Education followed suit, which explains the decrease in Welsh-speaking citizens. In recent years, however, there has been a push to bring Welsh back to the people.
Is Welsh, the language taught in school?

For a long time it was not, with a policy called the Welsh Not used in many places to ensure children spoke only English. However, in recent years Welsh has become a compulsory part of education for youth, and many universities have adopted Welsh programs as well, though English is still taught throughout.

There's a council funded by the Welsh government (the Welsh Books Council) which assists in promoting Welsh literature. Since 2016, the Welsh Language Commissioner requires all new or renewed road signs to be printed in both English and Welsh. messages.message: Hi! Can you tell me about Grenada?

By the 18th century, the name Grenada, or la Grenade in French, was in common use.

English is the country's official language. But, the main spoken language is either of the two creole languages.

Sure! On February 1763, the island of La Grenade was ceded to the British under the Treaty of Paris.

They received their independence in 1974.

Kenya is a country in East Africa, about half way down near the horn of Africa. It has the Indian Ocean to its east and Lake Victoria to the west.

Kenya is about the size of France and almost as large as Texas.

Obama was the first American President to to visit the country while in office, in 2015.

According to a report by the World Bank, close to half of the poorest 20 percent of the people in Kenya use a private health facility when children are sick.

That is so surprising! Thanks for chatting with me today.

Hi! Can you tell me about Hong Kong?

Hi there! Hong Kong, officially the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, is one of two Special Administrative Regions (SARs) of the People's Republic of China (the other is Macau. It is one of the richest and most highly developed places in China and even the world.
Interesting, Do you know anything about its Etymology?

Hong Kong literally means "Spice harbor or "fragrant harbor". There is a small stream running through Hong Kong and surrounding area which provide sweet and clear drinking water to resident. The stream was called "fragrance river" and Hong Kong received the name as the harbor city.
Cool! Can you tell me anything about their history?

Sure! Portuguese merchants established a trading poast called (Tamao) in Hong Kong waters, and began regular trade with southern China. After over a year of further hostilities, Hong Kong Island was formally ceded to the United Kingdom in the 1842 Treaty of Nanking.
Oh, are you saying the UK invaded them?
Britain occupied the island of Hong Kong on 25 January 1841 and used it as a military staging point. China was defeated and was forced to cede Hong Kong to Britain.
I see, so China got them back?
At midnight on July 1 1997, the crown colony of Hong Kong officially reverted to Chinese sovereignty, ending 156 years of British rule.
Thank you for your help! So informative!
You're welcome!

I'm a history buff so some historical information about the Democratic Republic of the Congo would be great.

The Belgian Congo achieved its independence in June 1960 under the name Republic of the Congo. A constitutional referendum in 1964 resulted in another name change to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Patrice Lumumba was the first Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic.

Protestants (excluding Seventh Day Adventists) 37.7%, Seventh-day Adventeists 11.8% and Muslims 2%; 0.2% claimed no religious beliefs and 1.3% did not state a religion.

Zersenay Tadese an Eritrean athlete formerly held the world record in the half marathon

messages.message: Hi, I want to learn about Peru?

Is there any specific subject you'd like to delve into more fully?

The Peruvian economy is the 48th largest in the world & the income level of its populace, which numbers about 31.5 million, is classified as upper middle class by the World Bank. Peru is the 4th most populas country in South America. The currency of Peru is the Nuevo Sol.
Why is Peru the 4th most populous country in South America?

Its population of 31.5 million makes it the 4th most populous country in South America. Its population has been driven by a strong economy. Inflation in 2012 was only 1.8%, the lowest in South America. Its current inflation rate, which has been influenced by a rise in oil & commodity prices, stands at 2.5%. Another contributing factor to the population size is the trade agreement signed with the U.S. in 2006.

Happy to tell you more about their infrastructure. The government of Juan Velasco Alvarado, which ran from 1968-75, introduced reforms, which included the the expropriation of foreign companies, introduction of an economic planning system, & the creation of a large state-owned sector. Reforms have permitted sustained economic growth since 1993, except for a slump in 1997 due to the Asian financial crisis.

Most reforms were not reversed until the 1990's when the government of Alberto Fujimori ended price controls, protectionism, restrictions on foreign direct investment & most state ownership of companies. Life expectancy in Peru is 72 years for males & 77 years for females, according to the 2016 data from the World Bank. That's all I have on infrastructure, but I have lots on the history of Peru I can share if that interests you.

Its a small state and shaped like the letter S and bordered on the west by Pennsylvania and Delaware across the Delaware River, on the north by New York, on the northeast by the Hudson River and New York City, on the east and southeast by the Atlantic Ocean and on the southwest by Delaware Bay.
That is very interesting! I would like to know their history there too.

On December 17, 1787, New Jersey became the third state to ratify the United States Constitution., which was overwhelmingly popular in New Jersey, as it prevented New York and Pennsylvania charging tariffs on goods imported from Europe.
I see. What else is interesting about their history?
McClellan, a native Philadelphian, had New Jersey ties and formally resided in New Jersey at the time, he later became Govenor in 1878.
What demographics do they have there?
New Jersey racial composition is White 67.92%, Black is 13.47% and two or more races is 2.56%
I see. What religions do they have there?
Nearly two-thirds consider themselves Christian, including 34% who are Catholic. Non Christian faiths accounted for 14% of Jew Jersey residents. Around 18% said they're unaffiliated with a religion.
Good to know! Thanks for the information!
You're most welcome.
Hey there. I'd like to learn more about Niue please.
Hello! Niue is an island in the south Pacific.
Cool. Can you tell me a little more about their economy?
Sure, the Niue Legislative Assembly passed the Niue Consumption Tax Act in the first week of February 2009, and the 12.5% tax on goods and services was expected to then take effect on April 1, 2009.
Cool. Can you tell me a little more about their economy?
Niue provides automated Companies Registration, that is administered by the New Zealand Ministry of Economic Development.
That's interesting. What about the geography?
The time difference in Niue is 23 hours during the Southern Hemisphere winter and 24 hours when New Zealand uses Daylight Saving Time.
Okay. Is there anything you can tell me about the terrain?
Niue is commonly known as "Rock of Polynesia." This is because it is situated between Tonga, Samoa, and the cook islands.
That's all I needed. Thanks.
No problem!

messages.message: Can you tell me about Zambia?
Officially it is the Republic of Zambia, a landlocked country in south-central Africa.
That sounds interesting. What about Zambia's history?
Formerly Northern Rhodesia, it became the Republic of Zambia in 1964 with Kenneth Kaunda as its first president.
Good to hear. What info can you provide about Demographics of Zambia?
In 1964, there were 70k Europeans in Zambia, many have since left the country.
Wow not a whole lot of people. Any more history facts?
Zambia declared its independent on the day of the closing ceremony of 1964 Summer Olympics. It was the first country to enter an Olympic games as one country and left as another.
Any other facts you can give me?
Archeological excavation work on the Zambezi Valley and Kalambo Falls show a succession of human cultures.
Thanks for all your help today. I appreciate it.
You're welcome.

Hello. I would like to learn about Iran please.
Iran is a country in Western Asia. Formerly known as Persia, it is part of the Middle East region, and borders Afghanistan, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Iraq, Pakistan, Turkey, and Turkmenistan.
I see. Will you tell me more about its geogprahy?
Certainly. It is officially called The Islamic Republic of Iran. Is capital and largest city is Tehran.
Interesting! How's their government and politics there?

There are two types of armed forces in Iran, They have the regular forces of the Navy, Air Force, and Army, as well as the Revolutionary Guards, with a total of about 545,000 active troops between both.
Cool. How's their politics?

The commander-in-chief, called the Supreme Leader, has control of security operations and military intelligence. He has sole power to declare war or peace in the nation and directly appoints the heads of the judiciary, the state radio and TV networks, the commanders of the police and military forces, and six of the 12 members of the Guardian Council.
That's crazy. What other information do you have for Iran?

Well, Iran's nuclear program has been the subject of contention with others in the international community, primarily the US. The regime is considered undemocratic and restrictive, and has persecuted and arrested critics of the government and the Supreme Leader.
Interesting! Thanks for the information!
You're welcome, have a great day!
